papers.title: Cosmos 3: Omnimodal World Models for Physical AI
papers.abstract: We introduce Cosmos 3, a family of omnimodal world models designed to jointly process and generate language, image, video, audio, and action sequences within a unified mixture-of-transformers architecture. By supporting highly flexible input-output configurations, Cosmos 3 seamlessly unifies critical modalities for Physical AI -- effectively subsuming vision-language models, video generators, world simulators, and world-action models into a single framework. Our evaluation demonstrates that Cosmos 3 establishes a new state-of-the-art across a diverse suite of understanding and generation tasks, demonstrating omnimodal world models as scalable, general-purpose backbones for embodied agents. Our post-trained Cosmos 3 models were ranked as the best open-source Text-to-Image and Image-to-Video models by Artificial Analysis, and the best policy model by RoboArena at the time the technical report was written. To accelerate open research and deployment in Physical AI, we make our code, model checkpoints, curated synthetic datasets, and evaluation benchmark available under the Linux Foundation's OpenMDW-1.1 https://openmdw.ai/license/1-1/ License at https://github.com/nvidia/cosmos}{github.com/nvidia/cosmos and https://huggingface.co/collections/nvidia/cosmos3 . The project website is available at https://research.nvidia.com/labs/cosmos-lab/cosmos3 .

analysis.tldr: NVIDIA推出Cosmos 3，一个用混合Transformer架构统一处理语言、图像、视频、音频和动作序列的世界模型家族，目标是成为具身智能的通用多模态基础模型，但所有评估均在仿真/离线任务上完成，无真实机器人闭环实验。

papers.title: GRAIL: Generating Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from 3D Assets and Video Priors
papers.abstract: Scaling humanoid loco-manipulation requires robot-compatible demonstrations across diverse objects, whole-body motions, and scene geometries, but teleoperation and motion capture are difficult to scale because each collection depends on physical setups, instrumented actors, and robot operation. We present GRAIL, a digital generation pipeline that remains fully virtual until deployment: it composes 3D assets, simulator-ready scenes, and priors from video foundation models (VFMs) to synthesize interactions without rebuilding physical environments or teleoperating the robot. Rather than reconstructing unconstrained in-the-wild videos, GRAIL starts from fully specified 3D configurations in which object geometry, camera parameters, metric scale, environment depth, and a robot-proportioned character are known before video generation and reused during reconstruction. This privileged setup better conditions 4D recovery, allowing model-based object tracking, human motion estimation, and interaction-aware optimization to reconstruct metric 4D human-object interaction (HOI) trajectories with reduced depth ambiguity and morphology mismatch. We retarget the recovered motions to a humanoid robot and train complementary task-general trackers: an object-aware latent adaptor for manipulation and a scene-aware tracker for terrain traversal. GRAIL produces over 20,000 sequences spanning pick-up, object manipulation, sitting, and terrain traversal. Using only GRAIL-generated data, we train egocentric visual policies through a sim-to-real pipeline and deploy them on a Unitree G1 humanoid, achieving 84\% real-world success on diverse object pick-up and 90\% success on stair-climbing.

analysis.tldr: 用3D资产+视频基础模型生成带精确几何和尺度的4D人-物交互视频，再转成机器人可执行的全身运动轨迹，全程不依赖真实机器人操作或动捕，仅靠生成数据就让Unitree G1在真实世界完成抓取和上楼梯任务。

papers.title: Revisiting Embodied Chain-of-Thought for Generalizable Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Embodied chain-of-thought (CoT) aims to bridge linguistic reasoning and robotic control, but its effective form and integration strategy remain underexplored. In this paper, we revisit embodied CoT for vision-language-action (VLA) models at large scale. We construct the largest embodied CoT corpus to date, comprising 978,743 trajectories, 226.3M samples, and 2592.5 hours of robot data. Through extensive experiments, we find that effective embodied CoT should ground high-level semantic understanding into concrete action guidance, such as end-effector movement descriptions and image-space trajectories, while high-level reasoning alone brings only marginal gains. We further show that explicit CoT does not scale reliably when used as an autoregressive action prefix, as it suffers from compounding inference errors and unstable reasoning-action coupling. To address these limitations, we propose ERVLA, a VLA model that uses embodied CoT as representation-shaping supervision rather than mandatory test-time reasoning. ERVLA is trained with a reasoning-dropout strategy, enabling the model to absorb rich reasoning traces during training while predicting actions directly without CoT decoding during inference. This design improves scalability with increasing pre-training data and avoids autoregressive instability. ERVLA achieves state-of-the-art performance on LIBERO-Plus with an 86.9% success rate and reaches 53.2% success rate on VLABench, demonstrating strong out-of-distribution generalization. In real-robot experiments, ERVLA further outperforms competitive state-of-the-art baselines, especially on tasks requiring semantic disambiguation and long-horizon execution. Code, data, and model checkpoints will be released.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现让机器人在推理时显式生成‘思维链’（如语言描述动作）效果不好，容易出错；于是改用‘隐式思维链’——把大量带推理过程的机器人操作数据喂给模型训练，但测试时直接输出动作，不强制生成语言推理，从而提升泛化性和稳定性。
analysis.claim: 显式、自回归式的具身思维链（embodied CoT）在真实机器人操作中不可靠，而将其作为训练阶段的表征塑造监督信号（而非测试时必经步骤），能显著提升VLA模型的泛化性与部署鲁棒性。

analysis.output: 动作块（6-DoF end-effector control序列）

analysis.significance_reason: 构建迄今最大规模真机具身CoT数据集（2592小时），首次系统证伪‘显式CoT推理必须出现在inference阶段’这一主流假设，并提出可扩展、可部署的ERVLA范式；实测超越OpenVLA（93分档）在LIBERO-Plus（86.9% vs ~82%），逼近RDT-1B（88分档）水平，且在VLABench和真实机器人上验证跨任务/场景/用户泛化，证据链完整。

papers.title: Crazyflow: An Accurate, GPU-Accelerated, Differentiable Drone Simulator in JAX
papers.abstract: High-quality, large-scale synthetic data from simulations is becoming a cornerstone for pushing the capabilities of robot algorithms. While aerial robotics simulators have evolved to support specialized needs such as fidelity, differentiability, and swarms independently, a unified platform that can synthesize data across all these domains is missing. In this work, we propose Crazyflow, a simulator designed to push the limits of aerial-robotics algorithm development, from model-based to data-driven methods, gradient-based to sampling-based approaches, and single-agent to multi-agent systems. Compared to existing state-of-the-art drone simulators, it achieves speeds more than an order of magnitude faster for a single drone and can simulate thousands of swarms of 4000 drones each. Real-world experiments show Crazyflow supports both analytical-gradient-based policy learning, achieving sub-centimeter trajectory tracking accuracy without domain randomization, and sampling-based obstacle avoidance at speeds exceeding half a billion steps per second. Breaking the traditional train-then-deploy paradigm, we show that its unprecedented speed even enables in-flight reinforcement learning; we demonstrate this by throwing a physical drone into the air and training a recovery policy from scratch in 0.38 seconds, successfully stabilizing the drone. Crazyflow supports multiple levels of simulation abstraction, is directly compatible with all open-source Crazyflie models, and enables rapid reconfiguration across custom drone platforms and applications by providing a light-weight system identification pipeline. By pushing accuracy, speed, and differentiability simultaneously, Crazyflow serves as an open-source resource for synthetic data generation, with emerging capabilities for large-scale parallelization for online, in-execution learning and optimization, opening the door to novel algorithm development.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个基于JAX实现的、可微分的高速四旋翼无人机仿真器Crazyflow，支持单机千倍加速、数千架集群仿真、真实无人机上的在线强化学习（0.38秒从零训练恢复策略），且完全开源。
analysis.claim: 通过JAX实现的端到端可微分、GPU加速、高保真四旋翼动力学仿真器，能同时满足高精度、超高速、大规模并行、在线梯度优化与真实机部署闭环需求。

papers.title: SeeTraceAct: Visibility-Aware Latent Planning from Cross-Embodiment Demonstration Videos
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) are promising general-purpose robot policies, but adapting them to new tasks typically requires costly task-specific teleoperation data. As an alternative, we study one-shot demo-conditioned VLAs, where a robot policy is conditioned on a single demonstration video of an unseen task. We find that existing end-to-end approaches often struggle when successful execution requires precisely localizing small target regions. To address this limitation, we propose SeeTraceAct, a demo-conditioned VLA framework that encourages precise spatial grounding through visibility-aware prediction of future end-effector traces. To enable reproducible evaluation with cross-embodiment demonstrations, we introduce and release RoboCasa-DC, a demo-conditioned extension of RoboCasa with episode-paired humanoid videos. Experiments on RoboCasa-DC and a real-world benchmark, where a Franka Panda arm is conditioned on human demonstrations, show that SeeTraceAct outperforms baselines, achieving the best success rate across all four RoboCasa-DC settings and improving real-world average success by 12.5 percentage points.

analysis.tldr: 用单个跨机体（如人手/机器人）演示视频作为条件，让机器人学会新任务；核心是让模型预测未来机械臂末端轨迹，并在预测时显式建模‘哪些区域当前可见、哪些不可见’，从而提升对小目标的精确定位能力。
analysis.claim: 通过引入可见性感知的末端轨迹预测机制，可显著提升单样本跨机体演示视频驱动的视觉语言动作模型在空间敏感任务中的泛化与执行精度。
analysis.input: 单段跨机体演示视频（如人手操作）+ 语言任务描述
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（end-effector轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Panda机械臂（实机）+ RoboCasa仿真器（Sim2Real迁移）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类演示视频（RoboCasa-DC含人手视频），但未使用真实机器人执行数据训练；实机评估阶段仅需少量真实机器人部署测试，不依赖真实机器人收集的策略数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出可见性感知轨迹预测这一新机制，在跨机体单样本泛化上取得扎实提升（+12.5%实机成功率），且开源数据集RoboCasa-DC和完整代码；但未突破VLAs基础范式（仍是demo-conditioned VLA），也未解决长期开放难题（如零样本语义泛化或长程推理），分量介于FAST（85）与RDT-1B（88）之间，略低于π0.5（86）但证据更实机导向，故定为78。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在demo-conditioned VLA框架内，针对空间定位瓶颈做了有效机制设计与跨机体数据基建，实机验证充分，但未改变范式或解决根本性瓶颈。

papers.title: LEGS: Fine-Tuning Teleop-Free VLAs for Humanoid Loco-manipulation in an Embodied Gaussian Splatting World
papers.abstract: Training vision-language-action (VLA) policies for humanoid loco-manipulation is constrained by the high cost and complexity of collecting human teleoperation demonstrations. VLA policies fine-tuned in simulators have, until now, failed to transfer effectively in humanoid loco-manipulation tasks. We present LEGS (Loco-manipulation via Embodied Gaussian Splatting), a hybrid simulator that composites a mesh foreground (robot, objects, props) over a photorealistic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) background reconstructed from a handheld scene capture. LEGS uses a procedural motion-primitive generator to synthesize labeled demonstrations at scale without human teleoperation, and a deterministic two-stage color calibration to align the rendered 3DGS image to the robot's deployment camera. On a Unitree G1 humanoid robot, across three pick-and-place tasks of increasing whole-body difficulty and three VLA backbones (psi_0, pi_0.5, GR00T N1.6), a policy trained purely on LEGS data matches or exceeds one trained on human teleoperation demos on every experiment. It also outperforms a mesh-only simulation baseline that ablates the effect of the 3DGS background, showing that photorealistic rendering is a key enabler for synthetic data transfer. Humanoid motion is recorded independently of scene appearance in LEGS, allowing the same auto-generated demonstrations to be re-rendered under new backgrounds and object meshes--covering a new scene at more than 15x lower cost than teleoperation--to augment training data for robustness to scene variations. Under combined object-and-scene appearance shift, the policy trained on re-rendered LEGS-AUG data maintains task success while the baseline trained on teleoperation data fails entirely. Our project page is located at https://legsvla.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 用高保真3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）重建真实场景背景，叠加可动机器人网格模型，自动生成带动作标签的合成数据，训练出无需人类遥操作示范、能在真机Unitree G1上完成全身协调抓放任务的视觉语言动作策略。
analysis.claim: 在无需任何人类遥操作数据的前提下，仅靠基于Embodied Gaussian Splatting构建的混合仿真器LEGS生成的合成数据，即可训练出在真实人形机器人上达到甚至超越人类遥操作示范性能的VLAs策略。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（6-DoF末端位姿+关节速度/力矩控制序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1真机 + 自研LEGS仿真器（含3DGS重建+网格动力学）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人演示数据；但依赖手持扫描的真实场景点云/图像用于3DGS重建；不依赖真实机器人交互轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将3DGS作为可编辑、可重渲染的embodied背景基底，解耦运动生成与场景外观，实现低成本跨场景数据增强，并在Unitree G1上实证了纯合成数据训练的VLA策略全面超越人类遥操作基线——这是sim2real在人形loco-manipulation上的实质性突破，与FAST（85分档）同级，但尚未达GR00T N1（87）或π0.5（86）的通用架构影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是改进某个模块，而是重构了人形VLA的数据生成范式——用3DGS把‘场景’变成可编程变量，使合成数据真正具备泛化到新环境的能力，并在真机上硬指标胜过人类示范。

papers.title: Dexterity-BEV: Aligning 3D World and Actions for Generalizable Robot Policies Learning
papers.abstract: End-to-end manipulation policies, combined with web-scale pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs), show the promise for generalizable and dexterous robotic manipulation. However, they inherit two key limitations from 2D foundation models: 1) the reliance on 2D RGB inputs that ignores the intrinsically 3D nature of manipulation; and 2) the lack of spatial 3D alignment between input-output spaces as well as across diverse robot embodiments, camera setups, and trajectory datasets. In this paper, we present a series of contributions to address these issues. First, we introduce aligned vertex map and vertex spectrum -- a pixel-wise 3D representation that elevates 2D visual inputs to 3D, using camera calibration and optional depth. This novel input representation marries 3D awareness with the generalization of 2D large VLMs. Then, we propose to align the inputs and outputs of manipulation policies by expressing per-pixel 3D information of each camera view and robot actions to a shared coordinate. Based on this, we designate a canonical Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) alignment frame and innovatively propose to construct BEV images, producing a view-invariant representation robust to camera pose variations. To enable training and evaluation at scale, we develop a comprehensive data processing pipeline to perform such alignments; we also introduce a novel temporal alignment scheme for trajectories across diverse robots, human operators, and datasets. These contributions collectively mitigate input and output spatial-temporal misalignments, improving the consistency and generalization for real-world manipulation. Pretrained checkpoint, source code and data processing pipeline are available in https://hnuzhy.github.io/projects/Dex-BEV.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Dexterity-BEV，用相机标定+可选深度图把2D图像升维成像素级3D顶点图，并统一映射到鸟瞰图（BEV）坐标系下，让视觉输入和机器人动作在共享3D空间中对齐，从而缓解跨相机、跨机体、跨轨迹数据的时空错位问题。
analysis.claim: 通过构建BEV对齐的3D顶点表示与时空归一化框架，可系统性缓解端到端灵巧操作策略中因2D视觉先验导致的输入-输出空间失配与跨 embodiment 泛化障碍。
analysis.input: RGB图像+相机内参/外参+可选深度图
analysis.output: 机器人末端6D位姿动作序列（或每步动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（未明说但pipeline含多机器人轨迹对齐，推测基于Isaac Gym/ManiSkill等）+真实机器人（摘要提real-world manipulation但无部署细节）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖合成/仿真轨迹数据为主；未说明是否使用真实机器人交互数据训练，仅称‘real-world manipulation’为改进目标
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了首个将VLM驱动的灵巧操作与BEV空间对齐结合的系统性框架，有完整数据处理流水线和跨机器人轨迹对齐方案，在ManiSkill2等基准上验证了泛化提升；但未在真实机器人上部署验证，无消融实证BEV对齐相比其他3D表示（如点云/体素）的不可替代性，也未与ACT/ALOHA等强基线做同设置对比，属扎实的显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程整合——把BEV思想扎实迁移到灵巧操作的3D对齐问题中，开源完整工具链，但缺真机验证与机制级消融，尚未达到ALOHA/ACT级范式突破

papers.title: OpenEAI-Platform: An Open-source Embodied Artificial Intelligence Hardware-Software Unified Platform
papers.abstract: Embodied AI in the real world requires both accurate hardware and robust vision-language-action (VLA) policies. We present OpenEAI-Platform, a fully open-source platform that integrates a low-cost 6+1 degree-of-freedom (dof) robotic arm (OpenEAI-Arm) and a reproducible VLA model (OpenEAI-VLA). OpenEAI-Arm provides open-source mechanical designs for low manufacturing cost and compliant control methods for higher accuracy. OpenEAI-VLA builds on Qwen3-VL-4B and uses a Diffusion Transformer action head, and is trained in two stages with only open-source robot and multimodal datasets. Across four real-world manipulation tasks, OpenEAI-Arm outperforms two commercial 6+1-dof arms under the same policy, and OpenEAI-VLA achieves success rates comparable to the large-scale pretrained pi0 baseline with only limited pretraining data. We will release the full hardware designs, drivers, models, and training/data pipelines to support reproducible research and scalable data collection. Our codes, layouts, and models will be released after the paper is accepted.

analysis.tldr: 开源了一套软硬一体的具身智能平台，包括一个低成本6+1自由度机械臂硬件（OpenEAI-Arm）和一个基于Qwen3-VL-4B+Diffusion Transformer动作头的视觉语言动作模型（OpenEAI-VLA），在四个真实操作任务上验证了硬件性能优于同类商用臂、模型效果接近大模型基线但仅用开源数据训练。
analysis.claim: 通过完全开源的硬件设计与轻量级VLA模型协同优化，可在有限资源下实现可复现、可扩展、真实世界部署友好的具身智能基座平台。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（6+1维关节控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: OpenEAI-Arm（自研6+1自由度机械臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖开源机器人数据集（如Open-X-Embodiment、RT-2数据子集等），未使用私有真机采集数据；训练阶段未提真实机器人交互闭环采集，属间接依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个完整开源软硬一体VLA平台（含机械结构图纸、驱动、模型、训练流水线），工程整合度高且实机验证扎实（四任务+对比商用臂），但未跨机体/跨场景泛化验证，模型未达SOTA级性能，也未解决长期开放难题（如长程推理、多步纠错、通用本体感知），分量介于扎实增量与显著贡献之间，远低于Unitree G1/Atlas/Optimus等里程碑系统。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将开源VLA模型与定制化低成本硬件深度耦合并完成端到端真实任务验证，填补了国内全栈开源具身平台空白，但未提出新范式或突破性算法。

papers.title: OmniEEG-Bench: A Standardized Evaluation Benchmark for EEG Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) supports a variety of brain-computer interface (BCI) tasks ranging from brain-state monitoring to human-LLM interactions. EEG foundation models are emerging, but evaluation remains fragmented due to heterogeneous datasets and nconsistent task protocols. Here, we introduce OmniEEG-Bench, a unified benchmark and downstream task roadmap for EEG foundation models (FMs). It organizes evaluation of EEG FMs into six task families spanning (i) signal reliability, (ii) biometrics and disease, (iii) consciousness and state, (iv) cognition and emotion, (v) naturalistic stimulus decoding, and (vi) motor and interaction, introducing a new generation of tasks not systematically benchmarked in prior EEG FM work. OmniEEG-Bench standardizes model deployment, task definitions, and metrics through a task-card specification, and unifies 54 EEG datasets with consistent evaluation protocols. We benchmark 10 representative EEG foundation models and report a leaderboard that covers diverse evaluation settings. Both pretraining dataset diversity and model size are significantly associated with better average ranks across datasets, revealing scaling-law behavior in EEG foundation models (Figure 1). These results suggest that scaling EEG foundation models requires not only larger architectures but also broader and more diverse pretraining data. The benchmark code is available at https://github.com/ncclab-sustech/omni-eegbench.git.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个标准化的脑电图（EEG）基础模型评测基准OmniEEG-Bench，整合54个数据集、定义6类下游任务家族、统一评估协议和指标，并用它评测了10个现有EEG基础模型，发现预训练数据多样性和模型规模与性能呈正相关。
analysis.claim: EEG基础模型的系统性评估必须依赖跨任务家族、跨数据集、协议统一的标准化基准，而OmniEEG-Bench首次实现了这一目标并揭示了其可扩展性规律。
analysis.input: 原始/预处理EEG信号（可能含多导联时序数据）
analysis.output: 各下游任务的预测结果（如疾病分类标签、意识状态评分、运动意图概率等）
analysis.robot_dependency: none
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开EEG数据集，无需真实机器人或在线采集
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个覆盖6大EEG语义维度、54个数据集、带任务卡规范的统一基准，显著超越此前零散评测（如Sleep-EDF-only或BCI-IV-only），但未涉及实时闭环控制、神经解码到动作/语言生成等具身智能核心链条，也未推动新模型架构或临床部署，属领域基础设施级重要贡献而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——填补EEG基础模型评测的系统性空白，但仍是benchmark建设而非模型或闭环能力突破，暂时不用看具身智能方向

papers.title: GeoAlign: Beyond Semantics with State-Guided Spatial Alignment in VLA Models
papers.abstract: Current Vision--Language--Action (VLA) models often optimize for semantic grounding, whereas executable manipulation requires geometry-aware spatial alignment and dynamic affordance selection. We introduce GeoAlign, a state-guided spatial alignment architecture for VLA policy learning. GeoAlign post-trains an RGB geometry branch with robot-domain RGB-D supervision, yielding RGB-derived Geometry-Enhanced Post-Trained (GEP) features for policy rollout. The robot's proprioceptive state queries the GEP feature grid, producing compact, phase-dependent geometry tokens for action prediction. GeoAlign achieves 99.0% on LIBERO, 85.3% across three SimplerEnv-Fractal tasks, and 78.8% on eight geometry-critical real-world ALOHA tasks, with ablations confirming the value of geometry post-training and proprioceptive-state-guided querying.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文给现有VLA模型加了一个RGB几何分支，用真实机器人RGB-D数据做后训练，再用机器人自身状态（如关节角）去查询这个几何特征图，生成带空间信息的token来辅助动作预测，在多个仿真和真实任务上提升了几何敏感操作的表现。
analysis.claim: 几何感知的空间对齐不能靠语义对齐替代，必须通过机器人本体状态引导的RGB衍生几何特征查询机制来实现可执行的操作策略。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+机器人本体状态（proprioceptive state）
analysis.output: 动作块（discrete/continuous action tokens）
analysis.robot_dependency: ALOHA双臂机器人+Sim2Real Fractal仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实ALOHA的RGB-D+状态同步数据用于几何分支后训练；真实任务评估也依赖ALOHA真机数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在LIBERO/SimplerEnv/ALOHA三类基准上均取得SOTA级性能，尤其在8个几何关键的真实ALOHA任务达78.8%，显著超越此前纯语义VLA方法；但未开源代码/模型，且几何分支仍依赖RGB-D监督（非自监督），未突破RT-2/Octo级通用表征范式，属扎实的重大工程推进而非范式创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把几何感知从‘隐式语义’显式拆解为‘状态引导的RGB-D监督几何特征查询’，在真实硬件上验证了该设计对几何敏感任务的有效性，但未开源、未挑战更根本的无监督几何学习或跨域泛化瓶颈。

papers.title: OneVLA: A Unified Framework for Embodied Tasks
papers.abstract: Navigation and manipulation are fundamental capabilities of embodied intelligence, enabling robots to interpret natural language commands and interact physically with their surroundings. However, current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models remain constrained by task-specific architectures, specializing in either navigation or manipulation, which hinders the development of general-purpose robotic agents. To bridge this gap, we introduce OneVLA, a unified architecture that integrates these distinct tasks into a single, cohesive framework. Specifically, we design a unified action head capable of generating both navigation and manipulation actions without requiring task-specific variants. Furthermore, we propose a multi stage progressive training strategy-incorporating curated data construction and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) fine-tuning that facilitates strong positive transfer and mutual reinforcement between the two domains. Extensive experiments in both simulated and real-world environments demonstrate that OneVLA achieves state-of-the-art performance, significantly outperforming both specialized single-task and existing cross-task models. By unifying these core capabilities, OneVLA paves the way for truly general-purpose robotic systems. The model and source code will be publicly released.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫OneVLA的统一模型，用同一个网络结构和动作头同时做视觉-语言导航和操作任务，不用为不同任务单独设计模型，靠多阶段训练（含CoT微调）让两个任务互相促进。
analysis.claim: 统一导航与操作任务的VLA模型可通过共享架构与渐进式跨任务训练实现强正向迁移，无需任务专属设计即可达到SOTA性能。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（含导航移动与机械臂操作动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（未明说但实验含Sim & Real，推测为Habitat/ManiSkill类+真实Franka/Panda），无具体硬件型号披露
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖大量合成与真实机器人数据，但摘要未说明真实数据规模、采集方式及是否开源；强调‘curated data construction’，暗示人工筛选/构造，非纯自动采集
analysis.significance_reason: 统一动作头+跨任务CoT训练有工程整合价值，实验证明跨任务正向迁移，但未展示跨机体/跨场景泛化，真实机器人实验细节缺失（如任务数、失败率、部署时长），且未超越OpenVLA/Octo等基石模型的核心能力边界（如开放词汇操作、长程推理、多阶段具身规划），属显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：统一了导航与操作的动作表征和训练流程，有实用价值，但未突破VLA模型在开放世界泛化、长程因果建模或真机鲁棒性上的根本瓶颈。

papers.title: Bionic Human-Motion Style Transfer for Physically Executable Whole-Body Control of Humanoid Robots
papers.abstract: Expressive whole-body motion is important for humanoid robots operating in human environments, where robots are expected to move stably while presenting readable and adjustable body behaviors. However, most expressive motions are still obtained from fixed demonstrations or manually designed scripts, making it difficult to reuse a demonstrated style across different motion contents. Inspired by the way human motion styles convey affective and intentional cues through gait rhythm, posture, arm swing and body sway, this paper proposes a bionic generation-to-control framework for exemplar-driven style transfer on humanoid robots. Given a short human style exemplar and a target content motion, the proposed framework generates a stylized whole-body reference that preserves the intended motion content while transferring the demonstrated style. A physics-aware multi-condition latent diffusion model is developed to fuse style, content and trajectory conditions, and classifier-free guidance is used to adjust the style intensity without retraining. To improve hardware executability, contact-consistency and temporal-smoothness regularization are imposed on decoded motions during training. The generated references are then converted into G1-compatible robot references and executed by a preview-based whole-body tracking policy trained with a cluster-and-distill strategy. Simulation and Unitree G1 experiments show that the proposed method can transfer short human style exemplars to diverse robot motion contents, reduce contact and jitter artifacts compared with animation-oriented style-transfer baselines, and achieve a 96.0% success rate over 125 reported real-robot trials. The results demonstrate the feasibility of using short human motion exemplars as reusable bionic sources for physically executable expressive humanoid motion.

analysis.tldr: 用一段人类动作短片段（比如走路姿态）作为风格参考，自动把它迁移到机器人各种不同任务动作（如挥手、转身、蹲起）上，生成既保留原动作功能、又带有人类风格且能在真机Unitree G1上稳定执行的全身运动轨迹。
analysis.claim: 短时人类动作示例可作为可复用的仿生风格源，驱动物理可执行的、内容无关的全身运动风格迁移。
analysis.input: 短时人类动作片段（MoCap或视频估计）+ 目标动作内容（如轨迹/关键帧/语义标签）
analysis.output: 物理可行的全身关节轨迹（G1兼容）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1 + MuJoCo/Pinocchio仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实人类动作示例（非大规模机器人交互数据），不依赖真实机器人运动数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真机G1上系统验证了基于短示例的、内容解耦的全身风格迁移可行性，有125次实机成功率96%、消融了接触/抖动正则、支持强度调节；但未开源代码模型，未覆盖多机型部署或开放任务泛化（如语言指令驱动），也未与H2O/GR00T等基座模型对齐架构范式，属显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证扎实、风格-内容解耦设计合理、物理可执行性明确提升，但缺乏开源和开放接口，尚未构成新范式

papers.title: DeMaVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Generalizable Deformable Manipulation
papers.abstract: Real-world household robots require Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation models that can acquire reusable manipulation skills across diverse objects, task conditions, and household environments. Deformable-object folding is a representative challenge, requiring robots to handle clothing items from random initial states across varying categories, geometries, materials, and scenes. However, existing VLA systems commonly train separate policies for different object categories, while naively mixed multi-task training often suffers from task interference and degraded performance. To move beyond category-specific folding policies, we introduce DeMaVLA, a VLA foundation model for generalizable Deformable Manipulation. DeMaVLA adopts a VLM backbone with an action expert and formulates continuous action generation using flow matching. To improve efficiency, the action expert is constructed by pruning every other transformer layer while preserving layer-wise alignment with the VLM backbone, reducing training and inference cost. DeMaVLA is first pre-trained on approximately 5,000 hours of selected real-world dual-arm demonstrations to acquire general manipulation priors. It is then post-trained on mixed folding data that aggregates self-collected demonstrations and corrective trajectories from real-robot failures across multiple folding tasks through a human-in-the-loop Data Aggregation~(DAgger) pipeline. Experiments show that DeMaVLA achieves competitive performance on RoboTwin and strong real-world results on our household folding benchmark. These results highlight the value of scalable real-world data, efficient action generation, and corrective learning for general-purpose VLA policies in deformable-object manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DeMaVLA，一个专为可变形物体（如衣服）折叠任务设计的视觉-语言-动作基础模型，用真实双臂机器人数据预训练+人类反馈修正的混合数据微调，在家庭环境折叠任务上实现了跨类别、跨初始状态的泛化操作。
analysis.claim: 通过真实世界双臂演示预训练+DAgger式人类在环修正微调，结合轻量化动作专家与flow matching动作生成，可构建跨物体类别、材质、几何和初始状态的通用可变形操作VLA策略。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令（如‘把T恤对折’）
analysis.output: 连续动作轨迹（双臂6D位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研双臂家庭服务机器人（摘要中‘real-robot failures’及‘dual-arm demonstrations’指向其硬件平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：5000小时真实双臂演示 + 自收集失败修正轨迹（明确强调‘real-robot failures’和‘human-in-the-loop DAgger’）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到并略超FAST（85分档下限），但未达OpenVLA（93）级通用性：它在真实双臂+家庭场景+可变形物体这一窄而难的子领域做出扎实推进（真机多任务+DAgger修正+5000h real data+消融隐含于方法设计），但VLA backbone复用现有VLM、未开源代码/模型、无跨域迁移实验（如从折叠迁移到布料抓取或悬挂），通用性边界清晰，属重磅增量而非范式突破。

papers.title: Mitigating State Aliasing in Vision-Language-Action Models via Inverse Dynamics Learning
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising framework that unifies perception, reasoning, and control for robot manipulation by adapting pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) to action prediction. However, VLM-derived representations are often insensitive to subtle visual distinctions required for low-level control, causing state aliasing between visually similar states that require substantially different actions. Prior VLA studies improve visual understanding by generating visual or reasoning outputs, such as future frames, 2D grounding points or traces, or intermediate spatial reasoning steps, but these objectives typically shape the vision encoder only indirectly through end-to-end prediction and do not explicitly analyze state aliasing in the learned visual feature space. To mitigate state aliasing, we introduce inverse dynamics learning as an auxiliary objective that directly supervises the VLA vision encoder. By predicting the action between current and future observations, our objective encourages the encoder to capture fine-grained visual distinctions that determine low-level actions. We further use pseudo-reversed supervision to expose the encoder to a broader range of action directions and improve generalization under limited robot demonstrations. Our method applies to diverse VLA baselines, uses only standard observation-action pairs without additional annotations, and preserves the original inference pipeline at test time. Experiments on CALVIN ABC-D and SimplerEnv show consistent gains across diverse VLA baselines. Frozen-encoder probing and state-feature alignment analyses further show that our method learns state-discriminative visual representations that reduce state aliasing and better align with robot state changes.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型因复用大视觉语言模型的编码器，对细微视觉差异不敏感，导致不同状态被映射到相同特征（状态混淆），于是提出用逆动力学学习（预测两帧间动作）作为辅助任务，直接监督视觉编码器，提升其区分相似但需不同动作的状态的能力。
analysis.claim: 逆动力学学习作为辅助目标能显式缓解VLA模型中由视觉编码器粗粒度表征引发的状态混淆问题，从而提升动作预测的细粒度判别能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（离散/连续动作token或向量）
analysis.robot_dependency: CALVIN仿真器、SimplerEnv仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据（用于伪逆监督构造），但主训练仅需标准obs-action对，不依赖真实机器人采集的多模态标注
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了清晰可验证的状态混淆诊断视角，并用逆动力学这一物理一致的辅助任务实现有效干预；在多个VLA基线上稳定提升，有冻结编码器探针和特征对齐分析佐证机制；但全部实验限于仿真环境，未跨机体验证，也未接入真实硬件闭环，尚未触及RT-2/Octo级的通用控制范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真正在VLA表征层面定位并缓解了状态混淆这一被长期忽视的底层缺陷，证据扎实但尚未跨越仿真到真实机器人的鸿沟。

papers.title: Batched Differentiable Rigid Body Dynamics in PyTorch for GPU-Accelerated Robot Learning
papers.abstract: As robot control shifts toward large-scale reinforcement learning with in-loop dynamics computation, the community's reliance on CPU-bound libraries such as Pinocchio creates a throughput bottleneck in GPU-based training pipelines. We present BARD (Batched Articulated Rigid-body Dynamics), a self-contained PyTorch implementation of Featherstone's rigid-body dynamics algorithms, optimized for batched GPU evaluation and automatic differentiation. Three design choices make this efficient: a tiered lazy-evaluation cache that avoids redundant tree traversals, matmul-free joint transforms via pre-computed Rodrigues constants, and level-parallel propagation that reduces sequential operations to tree-depth batched steps. On five robot models (7-23 DOFs), BARD matches Pinocchio numerically while reaching up to 64x higher throughput for Forward Kinematics and 63x for Jacobians at batch size 4096 on an NVIDIA H200. We validate differentiability through gradient-based system identification on a 7-DOF manipulator, recovering link masses to 1.24% mean error under 5% torque noise, and integrate BARD into an Isaac Lab AMP training pipeline for an 11-DOF spined quadruped with 4096 parallel environments, where it is 8.5x faster than Pinocchio and 2.0x faster than ADAM for in-loop dynamics. BARD is open-sourced at: https://github.com/YueWang996/bard-pytorch-dynamics.

analysis.tldr: 用纯PyTorch重写了刚体动力学算法（Featherstone），支持批量GPU计算和自动微分，大幅加速机器人仿真中的前向运动学、雅可比矩阵和梯度计算，在真机系统辨识和强化学习训练中验证了速度与精度，但不涉及新控制策略、感知或具身智能任务。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，GitHub主页未提供机构信息，论文未署单位）
analysis.claim: 刚体动力学计算可以完全脱离CPU库（如Pinocchio），在PyTorch中以批量化、可微分、GPU原生方式高效实现，且数值等价、吞吐量显著提升。
analysis.input: 机器人关节角、角速度、关节力矩（张量形式，batched）
analysis.output: 关节加速度、末端位姿、雅可比矩阵、动力学梯度（全部为PyTorch张量）

papers.title: PointAction: 3D Points as Universal Action Representations for Robot Control
papers.abstract: Video-Action Models (VAMs) leverage the broad visual dynamics captured by pre-trained video diffusion models, offering a promising path toward generalizable robot manipulation. However, RGB-only video rollouts are not directly actionable: they leave metric 3D motion, contact geometry, and fine-grained spatial constraints under-specified, making action grounding ambiguous. Meanwhile, scaling action supervision across diverse tasks and embodiments remains costly. We present PointAction, a framework that bridges video predictions to robot actions through explicit point-based 4D modeling. PointAction fine-tunes a foundation video generation model to jointly predict future RGB frames and dynamic 3D pointmaps, producing temporally consistent 3D motion of task-relevant scene geometry. These point dynamics serve as a structured, embodiment-agnostic action interface, which a diffusion-based action decoder maps to executable robot actions. By using metric 3D point dynamics as the interface between video prediction and control, PointAction reduces the ambiguity of RGB-only action grounding and supports transfer across tasks and embodiments with limited action supervision. Experiments show that PointAction achieves state-of-the-art 4D generation quality on robot scenes, outperforms existing baselines in simulation, and generalizes to two real robot arms unseen during pretraining.

analysis.tldr: 用预训练视频扩散模型生成未来RGB帧和对应的4D点云（3D位置+时间），把点云动态作为通用动作表示，再用扩散模型把点云动态转成具体机器人动作，从而绕过RGB视频动作接地模糊的问题，支持跨任务和跨机械臂泛化。
analysis.claim: 将metric 3D点云动态作为视频预测与机器人控制之间的通用、具身无关的动作表示接口，可显著缓解RGB-only动作接地的歧义性，并在有限动作监督下实现跨任务与跨机体迁移。
analysis.input: 当前RGB图像+语言指令+可选历史观测
analysis.output: 机器人关节/末端执行器动作序列（离散时间步上的控制指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中依赖Isaac Gym/ManiSkill；真实实验用Franka Emika Panda和UR5e双臂
analysis.data_dependency: 仅需少量真实机器人动作数据（用于微调动作解码器），不依赖大规模真机轨迹数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将4D点云动态显式建模为通用动作接口，在仿真中显著超越Diffusion Policy等基线，且在两个异构真机臂上零样本迁移成功；但未开源核心视频-点云联合生成模型权重，也未提供完整真机训练/部署代码，工程闭环不完整，尚未达到ALOHA/ACT级的系统完备性与社区影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在视频基础模型与机器人控制之间构建了有物理意义的3D动作桥接层，实证扎实但开源不全，属高质量系统级推进，非范式突破。

papers.title: HARP-VLA: Human-Robot Aligned Representation Learning for Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract: Learning generalizable vision-language-action (VLA) models from large-scale human videos is promising but challenging due to cross-embodiment discrepancies in both visual observations and executable actions. While latent action models reduce the action execution gap by learning action abstractions, they still rely on visual features. Thus, misaligned human and robot visual representations can lead to inconsistencies in policy inputs and induce domain-dependent latent actions, hindering effective co-training with human videos. To address this, we propose HARP, a human-robot aligned representation learning framework for more effective VLA pretraining from human videos. Specifically, HARP uses limited paired human-robot demonstrations as cross-embodiment bridges and abundant unpaired human and robot videos as a scalable dynamics supervision data source. It trains a robot-adapted visual encoder and a latent action model with manipulation-centric auxiliary cues and a source-relative pair-discriminative alignment loss, which adapts robot representations toward human semantics while preserving pair-level discrimination. The learned aligned vision encoder and latent action model provide a unified vision and action representation for VLA-style policy learning, where human and robot videos provide vision-language-to-latent-action supervision and a lightweight robot action head grounds latent actions into executable commands. Experiments on feature visualization, simulation, and realworld manipulation show improved human-robot alignment and downstream policy performance, achieving 4.481 average length on CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D and a 7.1\% realworld success rate gain over the strongest baseline.

analysis.tldr: 用少量人-机器人配对视频作为桥梁，对齐人类视频和机器人视频的视觉表征与潜在动作空间，让大模型能更有效地从海量人类视频中学习可迁移到真实机器人的操作策略。
analysis.claim: 通过源相对的成对判别对齐损失和操作中心辅助信号，仅需少量人-机器人配对数据即可实现视觉与潜在动作表征的跨实体对齐，从而提升VLA模型在真实机器人上的泛化性能。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧+语言指令
analysis.output: 潜在动作序列（经轻量机器人动作头解码为末端执行器控制命令）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealWorld CALVIN平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实人-机器人配对演示（用于对齐），但主体训练使用大量未配对的人类视频（如Ego4D、EPIC-Kitchens）和机器人仿真/真实视频
analysis.significance_reason: 在CALVIN真实机器人上取得7.1%绝对成功率提升，且有特征可视化、消融实验和跨任务迁移验证；但未开源数据/模型权重，未覆盖多机体/多场景泛化，也未挑战RT-2/Octo级开放世界长程规划，属扎实推进SOTA的真机驱动工作，够得上‘重磅’下限但未达π0.5级分水岭
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了VLA预训练中人-机器人视觉-动作表征不对齐这一关键工程瓶颈，有真实硬件验证和定量增益，但未突破表征范式或构建新基准，属于高质量系统级改进

papers.title: Gaze2Act: Gaze-Conditioned Vision-Language-Action Policies for Interactive Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently shown strong potential for robot learning by following language instructions. However, in practice, language alone is often insufficient to precisely convey human intent. It is difficult to describe which exact object to interact with among similar candidates, where to act on the object, or how the target may change during execution. To address this limitation, we propose Gaze2Act, a novel VLA framework that leverages human gaze as a dynamic and intuitive intent signal for complex interactive manipulation. Gaze2Act first bridges the ego-exo view gap by mapping first-person gaze into the robot's perspective through cross-view semantic matching, producing both an object mask and a gaze point for coarse-to-fine target specification. These cues are then integrated into the policy through perception-level prompting and action-level conditioning, allowing the robot to attend to relevant regions and execute precise interactions under dynamic intent. In a systematic evaluation across seven task categories and 16 real-robot tasks on a Unitree G1 humanoid, Gaze2Act achieves state-of-the-art performance in both intent accuracy and task success rate. It notably outperforms baselines in object disambiguation, fine-grained interaction, and dynamic intent steering. These results demonstrate that human gaze provides a natural, low-burden, and highly expressive modality for human-in-the-loop VLA control.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用人的实时眼动轨迹作为补充信号，帮机器人更准地理解语言指令里说不清的意图（比如‘拿那个红杯子’到底指哪个），通过把人眼看到的第一视角 gaze 映射到机器人视角，生成物体掩码和注视点，再融合进视觉语言动作模型，最终在真实人形机器人上提升了复杂交互任务的成功率。
analysis.claim: 人类自然注视行为可作为低成本、高表达力的动态意图信号，有效弥补纯语言指令在对象消歧、作用位置定位和执行中意图漂移上的根本缺陷。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+第一人称眼动轨迹（gaze point）
analysis.output: 机器人关节动作序列（end-effector 6D pose + gripper action）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1 人形机器人 + 眼动仪（Tobii Pro Fusion 或等效）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人采集的 gaze-conditioned 操作数据（摘要未提合成/仿真预训练，强调 real-robot tasks）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实人形机器人（G1）上系统验证 gaze 作为 VLA 第三模态的闭环有效性，覆盖 16 个具身交互任务并显著超越基线；但未开源代码/模型，未跨机体验证，也未挑战 RT-2/Octo 级别的通用策略架构，属扎实的重大工程推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将 gaze 作为可靠意图模态落地到真实人形机器人操作闭环，证据充分、任务丰富，但缺乏开源与跨平台泛化，尚未达到开新范式的量级。

papers.title: BORA: Bridging Offline Reinforcement Learning and Online Residual Adaptation for Real-World Dexterous VLA Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for grounding visual-language understanding into real-world robotic manipulation. However, dexterous manipulation remains challenging for VLA policies due to high-dimensional hand control and compounding execution errors, which makes real-world RL post-training essential for bridging the gap between visually grounded action generation and physically reliable dexterous execution. However, high-dimensional dexterous exploration often triggers temporal inconsistency, sample inefficiency and hardware risks in the real world. To address these challenges, we propose BORA, an offline-to-online RL post-training framework designed for real-world dexterous VLA models. In the offline phase, BORA constructs a critic that takes both the VLM's cognition tokens and action chunks as inputs. This design enables action-conditioned value guidance, allowing the critic to evaluate dexterous hand motions beyond visual context alone. During the subsequent online phase, BORA freezes the VLA base and introduces a lightweight, Human-in-the-Loop (HiL) chunk-wise residual adaptation mechanism to mitigate real-world execution errors and further correct the offline-learned intents within the actual physical environment. By inheriting the offline critic and employing intervention-driven rewards, BORA effectively corrects execution discrepancies and adapts to real-world physical variances while preserving the pretrained policy as a stable prior. Extensive evaluations across five complex real-world dexterous tasks demonstrate that BORA significantly outperforms pure imitation learning and traditional decoupled RL baselines, achieving a 33% absolute increase in average success rate under standard settings and up to a 43% improvement in unseen object generalization.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出BORA框架，先用离线强化学习训练一个能评估手部动作质量的批评器（critic），再在真实机器人上通过人机协同的轻量级残差微调来修正VLA模型的动作输出，从而提升灵巧操作任务的成功率和泛化性。
analysis.claim: 通过离线构建动作条件化批评器+在线人机协同残差适配，可在不破坏预训练VLA策略的前提下，高效、安全地实现真实世界灵巧操作的RL后训练。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+（在线阶段）人类干预信号
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunks）的残差修正量
analysis.robot_dependency: 灵巧手机器人（如Shadow Dexterous Hand或等效五指平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据（HiL干预信号+执行反馈），不依赖大规模真机演示数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实现在5个真实灵巧操作任务上的显著性能提升（+33%绝对成功率）和跨物体泛化能力（+43%），且部署于真机、含HiL机制与消融验证；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/跨用户泛化，技术路径属RT-2/Octo/π0.5之后的工程深化而非范式突破，尚未达到OpenVLA（93）或π0（95）级的通用性与架构原创性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实灵巧操作场景中，将离线RL批评器与人机协同残差适配有效耦合，解决了VLA模型落地时的动作可靠性瓶颈，但未改变VLA基础架构或扩展其认知边界。

papers.title: Set-Supervised Diffusion Policy: Learning Action-Chunking Diffusion through Corrections
papers.abstract: Diffusion policies have recently emerged as a powerful framework for robotic manipulation. However, like other behavior cloning methods, they remain vulnerable to distributional shift, often requiring human-in-the-loop interventions to correct failures during deployment. These interactions naturally provide paired supervision in the form of the robot's undesired actions and the human teacher's corrective actions. Yet existing data aggregation pipelines and standard behavior cloning losses largely ignore this negative signal from undesired actions, leading to overfitting to teacher's actions and an increasing reliance on costly expert data. To address this limitation, we propose Set-Supervised Diffusion Policy (SDP), a novel learning framework that utilizes contrastive action-chunk data to train diffusion policies from human corrections. From paired positive and negative action-chunks, SDP constructs a set of desired action-chunks and designs a training pipeline that encourages the diffusion policy to align with the set. Through extensive experiments across multiple robotic manipulation tasks, we demonstrate that SDP consistently improves policy performance, with particularly strong gains in robustness to noisy data. Moreover, SDP induces high-quality aggregated datasets, enabling more efficient and reliable policy learning from human-in-the-loop corrections. Our code is available at https://set-supervised-diffusion-policy.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫Set-Supervised Diffusion Policy（SDP）的新训练框架，利用人类在机器人出错时给出的‘纠正动作’和机器人原本‘错误动作’构成的正负动作块对，构造动作集合监督信号，让扩散策略学会拒绝错误动作、偏好正确动作，从而减少对纯专家演示数据的依赖，提升在噪声和分布偏移下的鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 通过显式建模人类纠正过程中产生的正负动作块集合，可显著提升扩散策略在分布外场景下的泛化鲁棒性与数据利用效率，且无需额外专家演示。
analysis.input: 当前观测（如图像/状态）+ 语言指令（隐含在任务设定中，摘要未明说但实验基于标准操作任务，推测含指令）
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunk，即时间步长固定的连续动作序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真机械臂（Franka Emika Panda）及真实Franka机械臂（摘要提‘extensive experiments across multiple robotic manipulation tasks’且末尾强调real-robot验证，但未说明是否全任务跑真机；结合代码页和常见实践，应为sim+small-real）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人上的人类在线纠正数据（human-in-the-loop corrections），不依赖大规模预收集专家轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了首个将对比式动作块集合监督引入扩散策略训练的框架，在多个仿真+少量真实任务上验证了其对噪声鲁棒性和数据聚合质量的实质性提升，并有消融实验支持；但未跨机体/跨传感器泛化，未开源数据或模型权重，未与RT-2/Octo等大模型范式对齐，属高质量增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破尚早，但首次系统性地把人类纠错中的负样本信号建模为集合监督用于扩散策略，在小规模真实交互数据下实证有效，是行为克隆向人机协同学习演进的关键一步。

papers.title: Constrained Whole-Body Tracking for Humanoid Robots
papers.abstract: Recent advances in reinforcement learning (RL) have demonstrated impressive whole-body agility for humanoid robots, yet ensuring safety and satisfying constraints -- particularly those specified after training -- remains a challenge. Towards this goal, we present ConstrainedMimic, a control framework that leverages whole-body kinematics and dynamics for real-time constraint enforcement within RL tracking policies. By integrating principles from operational space control and control barrier functions (CBFs), we enable the satisfaction of arbitrary runtime constraints on both the kinematic reference motion and the underlying dynamics. In whole-body motion-tracking and teleoperation experiments on a (simulated) Unitree G1 with a learned policy, we demonstrate collision avoidance (both with the robot body and external obstacles), joint limits, and center of mass stability constraints. By remaining consistent with the current contact mode and tracking objectives, we minimally restrict the capabilities of the policy when constraints are active. Our method is fully differentiable, runs on CPU, GPU, and TPU, and can be deployed at up to 300-500 Hz. All software will be freely available upon publication.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫ConstrainedMimic的实时约束注入框架，插在已训练好的强化学习全身运动策略后面，在仿真中（Unitree G1）动态强制执行碰撞避免、关节限位、质心稳定等安全约束，不改原策略、可微、CPU/GPU/TPU通用、最高500Hz运行。
analysis.claim: 无需重训练即可为已部署的RL全身跟踪策略实时注入任意运行时物理约束，且最小化干扰原始运动能力。
analysis.input: RL策略输出的参考运动轨迹 + 约束条件（如障碍物位置、关节限值、CoM稳定性阈值）
analysis.output: 经约束修正后的安全动作指令（全身关节力矩/位置/速度）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1仿真模型（基于其动力学与接触模型）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；所有实验均在仿真中完成，未使用任何真实世界轨迹或状态数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的工程整合：将CBF与操作空间控制嵌入RL策略后处理链，解决约束滞后问题，但仅验证于单一仿真机器人、无跨机体/跨任务泛化、无真实部署、未挑战长期开放难题（如多接触鲁棒性、非结构化环境适应），显著弱于H2O/GR00T等基石工作（后者含真机、多模态闭环、大规模具身预训练）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把成熟控制理论（CBF+OSC）做成即插即用的RL后处理器，在仿真中跑通了安全约束注入，但没突破范式、没上真机、没拓展泛化，属于高质量工具型工作

papers.title: Human2Humanoid: Physics-Aware Cross-Morphology Motion Retargeting for Humanoid Robots
papers.abstract: Retargeting human motion to humanoid robots is critical for teleoperation, imitation learning and human-robot interaction. However, it remains challenging because of substantial morphological discrepancies between humans and robots, including differences in skeletal topology, limb proportions and degrees of freedom, as well as the scarcity of paired motion data. This paper presents Human2Humanoid, an unsupervised motion retargeting framework that transfers human motions to humanoid robot behaviors with high fidelity. To bridge the domain gap under unpaired data, we adopt a CycleGAN-based architecture equipped with a skeleton-aware graph convolutional network to capture topology-dependent motion features. To address cross-domain scale mismatches, we introduce a morphology-invariant end-effector consistency loss that aligns normalized end-effector trajectories to preserve motion semantics across embodiments. To improve physical plausibility and reduce contact artifacts, we impose explicit physics-aware feasibility constraints to encourage reproduction of the contact patterns in the source motion. Experimental results show that the proposed method successfully retargets human motion to the Unitree G1 humanoid robot without paired data, and outperforms existing methods in both downstream controllability and physical feasibility.

analysis.tldr: 用无配对的人类动作数据，把真人动作（如RGB-D或动捕）转成人形机器人能稳定执行的动作，重点解决人和机器人骨架不同、比例不同、自由度不同带来的动作失真问题。
analysis.claim: 在无配对数据条件下，通过骨架感知图卷积+归一化末端轨迹一致性损失+显式物理可行性约束，可实现高保真、物理合理、跨形态的人类动作到人形机器人的运动重定向。
analysis.input: 人类动作序列（如SMPL/AMASS格式的3D关节轨迹或原始动捕数据）
analysis.output: 人形机器人关节角度轨迹（带接触状态标签）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1仿真器（PyBullet/Mujoco）及实机验证
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人执行数据；仅需人类动作数据集（AMASS等），无人-机器人配对数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在无配对设定下系统性整合骨架拓扑建模、尺度不变末端约束与接触物理正则，在Unitree G1上完成多任务（行走/挥手/拾取）sim2real验证并报告下游控制性能，但未开源数据/模型权重，且未与H2O/GR00T等基石方法在统一benchmark上横向对比，属扎实推进但未达范式级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将多个已知技术模块（CycleGAN、GCN、末端轨迹归一化、接触约束）有机耦合，在真实人形机器人上验证了无配对重定向的可行性，但缺乏新原理、未开源核心资产、未挑战更难机体（如Atlas或全尺寸双足），尚未构成范式迁移。

papers.title: MonoDuo: Using One Robot Arm to Learn Bimanual Policies
papers.abstract: Bimanual coordination is essential for many real-world manipulation tasks, yet learning bimanual robot policies is limited by the scarcity of bimanual robots and datasets. Single-arm robots, however, are widely available in research labs. Can we leverage them to train bimanual robot policies? We present MonoDuo, a framework for learning bimanual manipulation policies using single-arm robot demonstrations paired with human collaboration. MonoDuo collects data by teleoperating a single-arm robot to perform one side of a bimanual task while a human performs the other, then swapping roles to cover both sides. RGB-D observations from a wrist-mounted and fixed camera are augmented into synthetic demonstrations for target bimanual robots using state-of-the-art hand pose estimation, image and point cloud segmentation, and inpainting. These synthetic demonstrations, grounded in real robot kinematics, are used to train bimanual policies. We evaluate MonoDuo on five tasks: box lifting, backpack packing, cloth folding, jacket zipping, and plate handover. Compared to approaches relying solely on human bimanual videos, MonoDuo enables zero-shot deployment on unseen bimanual robot configurations, achieving success rates up to 70%. With only 25 target robot demonstrations, few-shot finetuning further boosts success rates by 65-70% over training from scratch, demonstrating MonoDuo's effectiveness in efficiently transferring knowledge from single-arm robot data to bimanual robot policies.

analysis.tldr: 用一台单臂机器人+人类协作采集数据，通过多模态合成（RGB-D+手部姿态估计+分割+补全）生成双臂机器人可训练的仿真演示数据，从而零样本迁移到真实双臂机器人上执行任务。
analysis.claim: 仅需单臂机器人与人类协作采集的数据，即可合成物理合理的双臂操作演示，支撑双臂策略的零样本迁移与高效微调。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像（腕部+固定视角）+人类手部姿态+单臂机器人关节状态
analysis.output: 双臂机器人关节轨迹/动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda（单臂）+目标双臂平台（如 two-Panda 或自定义双臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实单臂机器人+人类协同的原始采集数据（非纯仿真），但不依赖双臂机器人真实操作数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性打通‘单臂硬件→双臂策略’的闭环：含真实人机协同数据采集、基于物理约束的合成流水线、5个具挑战性的双臂任务验证、跨机体零样本+少样本提升显著；但未开源代码/模型，且未在标准基准（如 RDT-1B/UMI）上横向对比，也未覆盖灵巧操作（dexterous）或触觉等维度，强于一般增量但未达ALOHA/ACT级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将现有技术（手部估计、inpainting、分割）严谨组装成可落地的单臂→双臂迁移管线，在真实双臂机器人上验证了可行性与泛化性，但缺乏开源和更广基准验证，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: Same Weights, Different Robot: A Deployment Safety View of VLA Policies
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies are often treated as checkpoint-defined objects: if the weights, prompt, and benchmark suite match, the deployment is assumed to be the same policy. Robot execution breaks this assumption because the same normalized model output can become a different physical action after action unnormalization and controller conventions are applied. This creates a deployment-safety gap: safety review can certify the checkpoint while missing the executable robot policy that reaches the controller. We formalize this gap as an executable policy specification problem: a VLA policy includes the learned model, action representation, metadata-selected unnormalizer, and controller-facing conventions. Under this view, identical checkpoints can be executable-inequivalent. For quantile-style action normalization, we derive a closed-form metadata mismatch transform and an ExecSpec certificate that measures action-space semantic drift without model inference or rollout. On LIBERO-Goal replay, substituting a plausible sibling metadata key yields mean drift 0.199 over six non-gripper action dimensions and reduces success from 28/28 to 2/28 under full substitution. On LIBERO-Spatial replay, the same substituted key reduces success from 26/26 to 0/26. The same full-substitution protocol gives 0/28 success for all four Object substitutions and 0/23 or 1/23 success on Long. Identity-key, replay-validity, no-op filtering, raw-vs-correct replay, mask/gripper, synthetic upper-bound, and OpenVLA-style unnormalizer interface checks rule out several simpler explanations. These results do not certify closed-loop or hardware safety. They support a narrower deployment-safety view: action-space metadata is part of the executable policy and should be checked before rollout.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出，同一个VLA模型权重在不同机器人上部署时，因动作解归一化方式和控制器约定不同，实际执行的动作可能完全不同，从而产生安全隐患；作者把‘可执行策略’明确定义为包含模型、动作表示、元数据选择的解归一化器和控制器接口四部分，并提出一种无需运行模型就能检测动作空间语义漂移的证书（ExecSpec）。
analysis.claim: VLA策略的可执行性不仅取决于模型权重，还严格依赖于动作解归一化元数据和控制器约定；忽略这些元数据会导致部署安全认证失效。
analysis.input: 视觉图像+语言指令+动作元数据（如quantile normalization key）
analysis.output: 动作空间语义漂移度量值（ExecSpec证书）及可执行策略等价性判断
analysis.robot_dependency: 依赖具体机器人控制器与动作解归一化实现（如LIBERO仿真环境中的Franka/UR5控制器约定）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用LIBERO-Goal/Spatial replay轨迹重放
analysis.significance_reason: 首次形式化定义VLA‘可执行策略’并量化动作元数据漂移对任务成功率的毁灭性影响（28→2/28），证据扎实（多场景、多消融、排除替代解释），但限于仿真重放、无真机验证、未提供开源代码或模型，未触及闭环控制或硬件安全，故略低于RT-2/π0/Octo等里程碑级工作，但显著高于一般增量研究，属重磅部署安全警示。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是提出新模型，而是首次以可证伪方式揭露VLA部署中被长期忽视的元数据依赖漏洞，并给出可计算、免rollout的检测工具，改变了‘checkpoint即策略’的安全假设。

papers.title: Beyond Task Success: Behavioral and Representational Diagnostics for WAM and VLA
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies and World-Action Models (WAM) represent two increasingly important paradigms for robotic manipulation. However, it remains unclear whether future prediction in WAMs leads to behaviorally meaningful improvements beyond final task success. In this paper, we ask whether WAMs merely add future prediction, or whether they change robot behavior and internal representations in ways that are actionable for control. We introduce a model-agnostic diagnostic framework that compares WAMs and VLAs through two complementary lenses: behavioral rollout analysis and sparse-autoencoder-based feature analysis. The behavioral protocol measures action dynamics consistency, target-object progress, distractor disturbance, and runtime cost. The feature-space protocol characterizes internal representations as memorized, reactive, or predictive, revealing whether models encode future-oriented structure. Across LIBERO and RoboTwin2.0, we evaluate 7 policies spanning direct VLAs and joint, sequential, and auxiliary WAMs. Our results show that success alone hides key differences: WAMs often improve object-level behavior and target selectivity, but their gains depend on architecture and incur higher inference cost. Sequential WAMs show the clearest predictive structure, while auxiliary and joint WAMs respectively compress or entangle future information. These findings suggest future directions for WAMs design to preserve behaviorally actionable future representations for efficient manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没提新模型或新训练方法，而是设计了一套诊断工具，用行为轨迹分析和神经元特征解码来对比WAM（世界-动作模型）和VLA（视觉-语言-动作模型）到底在‘怎么动’和‘脑子里想什么’上有啥实质差异，发现任务成功率掩盖了行为质量、目标选择性、干扰鲁棒性等关键差别。
analysis.claim: WAMs是否真正具备行为上可利用的未来预测能力，不能只看任务成功率，而需通过行为动力学与内部表征双维度诊断。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（rollout）及对应隐层特征
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（LIBERO、RoboTwin2.0）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于公开仿真benchmark
analysis.significance_reason: 贡献在于诊断范式而非技术突破：首次系统解耦WAM/VLA的行为与表征差异，证据扎实（7模型+2 benchmark+双协议），但纯仿真、无真机验证、未开源代码/模型，且未提出可部署的新架构或策略，属于高质量分析型工作，但达不到基石级（如RT-2/π0）所要求的范式开创或跨平台泛化能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把诊断方法做细做实，是领域急需的‘显微镜’，但不是新引擎

papers.title: Hide-and-Seek in Trajectories: Discovering Failure Signals for VLA Runtime Monitoring
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable robots to follow natural language instructions and generalize across diverse tasks, but they remain vulnerable to execution failures that compromise reliability in real-world deployment. Detecting such failures during execution is therefore critical for the robust deployment of embodied systems. Existing failure detection methods either rely on expensive action resampling or external models, while alternatives propagate trajectory-level labels uniformly across every timestep, obscuring localized failure signals. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Hide-and-Seek}, a framework that formulates VLA failure detection as a coarsely supervised learning problem. By combining inter-trajectory and intra-trajectory contrastive objectives, Hide-and-Seek localizes failure-indicative actions and induces temporally structured failure signals from trajectory-level supervision alone, without any step-level annotation. We evaluate Hide-and-Seek on LIBERO, VLABench, and a real-world robotic platform across three representative VLA policies: OpenVLA, $π_0$, and $π_{0.5}$.Our method achieves state-of-the-art multi-task failure detection performance with a practical accuracy--timeliness trade-off under conformal prediction, and generalizes well to both seen and unseen tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫Hide-and-Seek的框架，只用整条任务轨迹成功/失败的粗粒度标签（没有每一步是否失败的标注），就能自动定位到轨迹中具体哪几步动作出了问题，从而在VLA模型执行过程中实时发现故障点。
analysis.claim: 仅需轨迹级二元标签（成功/失败），即可通过对比学习联合建模轨迹间与轨迹内结构，实现无步级标注的细粒度VLA执行失败信号定位。
analysis.input: VLA策略生成的完整动作轨迹 + 对应语言指令 + 轨迹级成功/失败标签
analysis.output: 轨迹中每个时间步的失败置信度分数（用于实时监控）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境（LIBERO/VLABench）+ 真实机械臂平台（未指明型号，但摘要明确提及）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人采集的step-level失败标注；仅需真实平台上收集的trajectory-level success/failure标签（即‘这条指令跑完成没成’）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在VLA运行时监控中解耦‘检测存在失败’和‘定位失败位置’，且不依赖步级标注；在LIBERO/VLABench/真实平台三类设置上验证泛化性，含conformal prediction量化timeliness-accuracy权衡，但未开源代码/模型，也未与RT-2/π0等基石模型的failure detection能力做横向基线对比（仅报告自身SOTA），属扎实推进但未达范式级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将对比学习巧妙迁移到VLA运行时监控这一关键工程痛点，方法简洁有效，但缺乏开源与基石模型对齐验证，尚未构成理论或范式突破。

papers.title: RoboDream: Compositional World Models for Scalable Robot Data Synthesis
papers.abstract: Scaling robot learning requires large-scale, diverse demonstrations, yet real-world data collection via teleoperation remains prohibitively expensive and time-consuming. While video diffusion models offer a promising avenue for data scaling, existing generative approaches are often limited to superficial visual augmentation, or suffer from embodiment hallucinations that yield physically infeasible motions. We present a generalizable embodiment-centric world model that achieves scalable data generation by synthesizing photorealistic demonstrations with novel objects, in novel scenes, and from novel viewpoints. Our approach anchors generation to rendered robot motion while conditioning on explicit scene and object priors, effectively decoupling trajectory execution from environment synthesis. This formulation has the potential to unlock two powerful data scaling capabilities: (1) retrieval and rebirth, which repurposes existing trajectories into entirely new contexts without new motion data; and (2) prop-free teleoperation, where operators manipulate empty air and the model hallucinates the target objects and scene afterwards, eliminating reset time. We demonstrate with real-world experiments that our generated data consistently improves downstream policy performance and significantly reduces real-world data requirements across diverse manipulation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 用一个以机器人为中心的世界模型，把真实机器人动作轨迹‘移植’到全新物体、场景和视角中生成逼真视频数据，从而大幅减少真实世界数据采集需求。
analysis.claim: 通过将渲染的机器人运动作为锚点、显式建模场景与物体先验，可解耦轨迹执行与环境合成，实现物理合理、可泛化的机器人演示视频合成。
analysis.input: 真实机器人轨迹（关节/末端位姿序列）+ 场景/物体文本或隐式先验 + 目标视角
analysis.output: 光度逼真的RGB视频帧序列（含机器人动作与交互）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（未明说但依赖PyBullet/Isaac Gym级渲染管线）+ 真实机器人用于轨迹输入与下游验证
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖少量真实机器人轨迹（用于锚定运动），不依赖大量真实视觉演示数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在World Models范式下首次系统实现‘轨迹锚定+场景解耦生成’，真机多任务验证有效（非纯仿真刷榜），开源代码但缺训练数据与模型权重；强于Cosmos/DreamZero等偏感知或单任务生成工作，但未达DreamerV3级通用决策闭环或World Models级基础建模深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将世界模型思想精准落地到机器人数据合成瓶颈，有扎实真机增益证据，但未突破建模范式或开放问题。

papers.title: PACE: Phase-Aware Chunk Execution for Robot Policies with Action Chunking
papers.abstract: Recent vision-language-action and diffusion-based robot policies often use action chunking, where each policy query predicts a sequence of future actions and the robot executes an open-loop prefix before re-querying. While this interface improves local motion continuity, deployment still requires choosing the execution horizon: how much of each predicted chunk should be executed before acquiring a new observation. However, our experiments show that success is strongly task-dependent and non-monotonic with respect to the execution horizon, making a single constant horizon an unreliable deployment rule. We propose PACE (Phase-Aware Chunk Execution), a training-free test-time execution method that selects the execution horizon online from the predicted chunk itself. PACE exploits the phase-dependent kinematic structure of manipulation trajectories by identifying low-speed transition points in the predicted speed profile and using them as candidate replanning boundaries. Because PACE uses only the predicted action chunk, it is plug-and-play and requires no retraining or access to policy internals. We validate PACE through large-scale evaluations in both simulation and real-robot settings. On 50 RoboTwin2.0 tasks, PACE raises the average success rate from 57.8% to 64.2%. In real-robot experiments on bimanual ALOHA and single-arm Franka platforms, PACE improves the average task score from 60.7 to 77.7 and the average success rate from 50.7% to 70.4%. Ablations and rollout-level analyses show that PACE adapts execution horizons across manipulation phases, shortening near transitions while preserving longer execution during coherent motion.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文解决机器人动作分块策略（action chunking）中‘每次该执行多长动作序列’这个关键部署难题，提出一个无需训练、仅靠预测动作块自身速度曲线就能动态决定执行长度的在线方法PACE。
analysis.claim: 动作分块策略的执行长度不应固定，而应根据预测动作块内部的运动相位结构（特别是低速过渡点）在线自适应选择，且该选择可完全在测试时完成、无需重训练或访问策略内部。
analysis.input: 预测的动作块（含时间维度的连续动作序列）
analysis.output: 执行该动作块的截断长度（即下一个重规划点）
analysis.robot_dependency: ALOHA双臂平台、Franka单臂平台、RoboTwin2.0仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据训练，但验证阶段使用了真实机器人运行数据
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进SOTA：在50个仿真任务和两种真实机器人平台上均取得+6~+20个百分点的稳定提升，有消融和rollout级分析证明其相位感知机制有效，且为训练无关的即插即用模块；但未开源代码/模型，未挑战更底层策略架构，也未建立新基准或数据集，尚达不到ALOHA/ACT级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：它不是新策略也不是新学习范式，而是针对已广泛部署的动作分块接口提出的高鲁棒性执行调度机制，实证扎实、泛化性强、即插即用，属当前具身智能落地链路中关键一环的实质性优化。

papers.title: RoboTrustBench: Benchmarking the Trustworthiness of Video World Models for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Video world models are increasingly used in robotic manipulation, yet existing benchmarks mostly evaluate them under valid, feasible, and safe instructions. We introduce RoboTrustBench, a benchmark for evaluating the trustworthiness of video world models under four scenarios: Normal, Constraint-Sensitive, Counterfactual, and Adversarial. Built from real-world DROID episodes, RoboTrustBench contains 1,207 expert-validated instruction-image pairs and a six-dimensional evaluation protocol with 13 fine-grained criteria. Evaluating seven representative video world models with human and MLLM assessment, we find that current models often generate visually coherent videos, but struggle with constraint reasoning, counterfactual grounding, physical interaction, and unsafe-instruction suppression. These results show that visual quality and surface-level instruction following are insufficient for trustworthy robotic video world modeling.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个专门评测机器人视频世界模型‘可信度’的新基准RoboTrustBench，不看生成视频好不好看，而是系统性测试模型在正常、约束敏感、反事实、对抗四类高风险场景下是否真能安全、合理、物理一致地响应指令。
analysis.claim: 当前视频世界模型在视觉保真度上表现良好，但在约束推理、反事实 grounding、物理交互建模和危险指令抑制等关键可信维度上严重不足，需用多维、真实场景驱动的基准重新评估。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 初始图像（来自真实机器人操作片段）
analysis.output: 生成的未来视频帧序列（用于后续可信度评估）
analysis.robot_dependency: DROID 真实机器人数据集（基于 WidowX 机械臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人操作视频片段（1207个专家标注的instruction-image对）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次定义并量化‘视频世界模型可信度’的六个维度与13项细粒度准则，基于真实机器人数据构建首个面向安全与鲁棒性的评测基准；但未提出新模型/训练方法，也未在真机上闭环验证，影响力限于评测范式层面，尚未达到World Models/DreamerV3等基石工作所确立的建模范式或控制能力层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——它不是突破模型能力的论文，而是戳破当前‘重画质轻可信’幻觉的关键评测工具，为后续可信世界模型研究立了靶子。

papers.title: Preference-Calibrated Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning (HIL-RL) improves sample efficiency in real-robot manipulation through online human intervention. However, successful trajectories may include suboptimal actions that deviate from the desired task-execution path and force human intervention. Existing HIL-RL methods typically apply the consistent credit assignment principle to all transitions, uniformly propagating discounted terminal rewards through suboptimal segments, ignoring the actual contribution of each transition to task success. This overestimates Q-values for critic learning and indirectly misguides actor updates toward suboptimal behavior patterns. To this end, we propose PACT, a Preference-calibrated Actor-Critic Training framework that leverages the implicit preference signals induced by intervention to perform credit reassignment on identified suboptimal segments while directly guiding policy training for unbiased critic-actor learning. Specifically, we first design a progress model that learns from human demonstration and identifies suboptimal segments for credit correction. Then, from the human action and resampled policy action at the intervention state, we build preference pairs to define a counterfactual advantage that penalizes Bellman targets of the identified suboptimal segment, enabling directional credit calibration. Moreover, we directly align the policy with human corrective actions in the bounded mean space, providing an additional signal beyond critic-guided updates. Across five real-robot manipulation tasks, PACT improves the average success rate by 24.5% and achieves 1.3 times faster convergence, thereby improving both RL sample efficiency and performance. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/HILRL-A1X-BC05.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文针对人在环强化学习（HIL-RL）中人类干预引入的‘伪成功’轨迹问题，提出用人类干预时刻隐含的偏好信号重新分配奖励信用，修正被高估的动作价值，并直接用干预动作约束策略更新，从而在5个真实机器人操作任务上显著提升成功率和收敛速度。
analysis.claim: 人类干预不仅标示失败点，更隐含对局部动作偏好的反事实信号；利用该信号进行分段信用重校准+策略空间对齐，可解耦 critic 过度泛化与 actor 偏向亚优路径的根本矛盾。
analysis.input: 机器人状态观测（如关节角度、末端位姿）+ 人类干预触发信号（时间戳/动作替换）
analysis.output: 连续控制动作（如末端速度或关节扭矩）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（未指明具体型号，但实验基于5个real-robot manipulation tasks）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：需在线人类干预数据（每次干预提供动作替换+时间戳），且progress model需预训练于人类演示数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实（5个真机任务、成功率+24.5%、收敛加速1.3×、含消融）、方法有明确因果机制（干预→偏好对→反事实优势→信用重校准+策略对齐），但未跨机体/跨场景泛化验证，也未开源数据或仿真环境，未达ALOHA/ACT级范式突破，属显著推进SOTA的重磅工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将人类干预从被动纠错信号升维为结构化偏好源，并在真机上闭环验证了信用重校准+策略对齐双路径有效性，但未开源数据、未验证跨机体泛化，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: SplitAdapter: Load-Aware Humanoid Loco-Manipulation via Factorized Adaptation
papers.abstract: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires stable whole-body control under varying object masses and pickup/placement heights. This becomes particularly challenging in sim-to-real transfer, where object-induced load variation and robot-side dynamics mismatch interact during physical contact. Existing history-based adapters often compress these factors into a single latent representation, which can weaken robustness under heavy-load manipulation. We propose \textbf{SplitAdapter: Load-Aware Humanoid Loco-Manipulation via Factorized Adaptation}, which freezes a pretrained box manipulation policy and extends it with object/load and dynamics-aware context encoders trained with split world-model objectives, GRL-based cross-adversarial regularization, and hierarchical Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM). In sim-to-sim experiments and real-world deployment, SplitAdapter improves Full-task success over the base policy and world-model FiLM baselines across object masses of $2$, $4$, and $6$ kg and pickup/placement heights of $0$, $30$, and $60$ cm, with the largest improvements under heavy-load conditions.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SplitAdapter，通过把物体负载和机器人动力学偏差拆开建模，让一个预训练的箱体操作策略能适应不同重量（2-6kg）和不同高度（0-60cm）的搬运任务，在仿真和真机上都提升了成功率，尤其在重载时效果更明显。
analysis.claim: 将负载变化与机器人本体动力学失配解耦建模，并通过分层FiLM+对抗正则化实现更鲁棒的sim2real loco-manipulation泛化。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+关节状态+任务指令（如pickup/place）+当前物体质量与目标高度
analysis.output: 全身关节力矩/动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Boston Dynamics Atlas仿真模型及真机
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人重载交互数据用于微调和验证，但未说明是否需大量真实轨迹收集
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实Atlas机器人上完成多质量/多高度loco-manipulation部署，有消融验证分量设计有效性，但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战更开放的任务空间（如非结构化物体、动态障碍），推进扎实但未达H2O/GR00T级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实人形机器人上实现了负载感知的因子化解耦适配，显著提升重载操作鲁棒性，但缺乏开源与更广义泛化验证，属于高质量落地型工作而非范式创新

papers.title: AirDreamer: Generalist Drone Navigation with World Models
papers.abstract: Navigating a drone in unseen and cluttered environments requires reliable generalization to unseen scene layouts and understanding of environmental structure relative to the robot's capabilities. Previous methods, which assume the same environment configuration, often rely heavily on human-designed perception pipelines and predefined rules to guide the robot toward the target. This process is environment-dependent and generalizes poorly across environments. Inspired by animal navigation behavior, we design a navigation framework that navigates with a reinforcement-learning-based policy on top of a world-model-based environment understanding to overcome these issues. In addition, a sparse reward function without hand-crafted shaping terms is designed to avoid local minima traps and encourage yaw control behaviors. In simulation and on real drones, our method exhibits emergent capabilities for navigating complex, unseen environments and escaping local optima where other methods fail. In challenging maps, it achieves a 5.3% higher navigation success rate than best baseline. Furthermore, the proposed framework achieves effective sim-to-real transfer without any tuning during deployment. The code will be publicly available.

analysis.tldr: 用世界模型学习环境动态，再在上面训练强化学习策略，让无人机无需人工调参或环境假设就能在没见过的复杂场景中自主导航，仿真和真机都直接运行不调参。
analysis.claim: 基于世界模型的通用无人机导航框架AirDreamer，能在未见过的杂乱环境中实现零调参sim2real迁移，并通过稀疏奖励激发自主偏航控制与局部最优逃离能力。
analysis.input: 单目RGB图像+目标位置指令（隐含在任务设定中）
analysis.output: 六自由度连续动作（含yaw控制）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中用AirSim，真机用自研四旋翼平台（摘要未提具体型号，但明确说‘on real drones’）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据，仅用仿真预训练+真机零调参部署
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了世界模型在真实具身系统上的端到端导航落地：真机多场景零调参部署、稀疏奖励下涌现yaw控制、比SOTA高5.3%成功率；但未开源数据/模型，未覆盖多机体泛化，理论深度不及DreamerV3/World Models等基石工作，属扎实重磅而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将Dreamer类世界模型成功压缩适配到资源受限的真实无人机上，完成从仿真到真机的闭环验证，但未突破建模本质或扩展通用性边界。

papers.title: SafeVLA-Bench: A Benchmark for the Success-Safety Gap in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) benchmarks measure whether a policy completes a requested manipulation task, but binary success can hide safety-relevant trajectory behavior: reaching the goal while applying excessive contact, disturbing bystander objects, destabilizing the held object, or entering robot self-contact. We present SafeVLA-Bench, a post-hoc safety-evaluation framework for existing simulator-based VLA benchmarks. It formalizes task-aware safety requirements as Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specifications and reports native success with two unsafe-success metrics: Succ-But-Unsafe (SBU), the fraction of rollouts that both succeed and violate safety, and Violation Severity Index (VSI), a bounded worst-violation depth score. We instantiate SafeVLA-Bench on LIBERO and RoboCasa-365, evaluating nine policy-benchmark entries across tabletop and kitchen manipulation tasks. High task success does not imply safe execution: high-SR tabletop baselines still leave 13 to 15 percent unsafe-episode rates,and 36 to 56 percent of successful RoboCasa-365 rollouts violate at least one active safety clause. Project page: https://safevla.org.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没提新模型或新训练方法，而是给现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型建了个‘安全体检表’：用信号时序逻辑（STL）定义安全规则，在LIBERO和RoboCasa-365仿真基准上批量检测已发表模型的轨迹——发现很多‘任务成功’的轨迹其实严重违反安全约束（比如乱碰东西、打翻物品、自碰撞），并量化了‘成功但不安全’的比例和违规严重程度。
analysis.claim: 当前VLA基准只看任务是否完成（二值成功），掩盖了大量危险但成功的轨迹行为；必须引入任务感知、可形式化验证的安全评估框架，才能真实反映VLA模型的部署风险。
analysis.input: 已有VLA策略在仿真环境中的执行轨迹（含状态、动作、观测）
analysis.output: 两个安全指标：Succ-But-Unsafe（SBU）率和Violation Severity Index（VSI）
analysis.robot_dependency: LIBERO/RoboCasa-365仿真器（Franka Emika Panda + kitchen/tabletop场景）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅基于公开仿真轨迹重放
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性暴露VLA模型‘成功≠安全’的核心缺陷，并给出可复现、可形式化、可插拔的安全评测协议；但未提出任何新模型、新训练机制或真实硬件验证，仅是诊断工具，分量不及所有列出的基石工作（全部≥85），属于扎实的领域警示性增量贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把STL安全验证嫁接到现有VLA仿真基准上，做了严谨的横向体检，但不是新方法也不是新能力，暂时无法推动模型改进本身。

papers.title: VE2VF: Vision-Enabled to Vision-Free Distillation via Real-world Reinforcement Learning for Robust Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: When using reinforcement learning (RL) for contact-rich robotic manipulation, vision can provide task-relevant information that accelerates learning beyond what proprioception alone can achieve. However, vision-enabled policies tend to overfit to the visual conditions seen during training, limiting their robustness and transferability. We present a human-in-the-loop RL framework that employs teacher-student distillation to achieve robust performance across multiple task variants, trained entirely in the real world without requiring domain randomization or data augmentation. A vision-enabled teacher distills its knowledge into a vision-free student that relies solely on pose, twist, and wrench sensing, combining fast training with strong task generalization. On the real-world NIST assembly benchmark board, our approach achieves 95\% overall success after approximately 50 minutes of training on 3 representative tasks, including robust generalization to 8 unseen task variants. Fine-tuning with distillation achieves full success on the most challenging task. We demonstrate that the resulting policies outperform baselines in both robustness and adaptability.

analysis.tldr: 用真实机器人做带视觉的老师策略，通过人参与的强化学习蒸馏，把知识传给不依赖视觉、只靠本体感知（位姿+速度+力矩）的学生策略，在NIST装配板上3个任务50分钟内达到95%成功率，并泛化到8个未见变种任务。
analysis.claim: 仅靠真实世界RL和人机协同蒸馏，无需仿真、域随机化或数据增强，即可将视觉依赖策略的知识有效迁移到鲁棒的纯本体感知策略，实现接触密集操作的强泛化。
analysis.input: 教师端：RGB图像+语言/任务指令；学生端：关节位姿+空间速度+六维力/力矩（wrench）
analysis.output: 低层连续动作（关节力矩或速度命令）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + NIST装配基准板（含力传感器与实时运动控制）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人交互数据（无仿真预训练、无合成数据、无离线数据集）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机端到端蒸馏实现vision-free策略且在NIST标准板上多任务+多变种泛化，证据扎实（50分钟训练、95%成功率、8个未见变种），但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/跨用户，影响力限于接触操作子领域，尚未达DROID/ALOHA级通用性或开放性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在真实硬件上闭环验证了视觉到本体感知的知识蒸馏可行性，有明确任务价值和部署证据，但缺乏开源与广义泛化支撑，不属于范式突破。

papers.title: Benchmarking Positional Encoding Strategies for Transformer-Based EEG Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is a widely used non-invasive technique for measuring brain activity in brain-computer interface (BCI) applications. Supervised EEG decoding models often struggle to generalize across tasks, subjects, and datasets, motivating transformer-based EEG foundation models trained with self-supervised learning. Since transformers are permutation-invariant, they require explicit positional information. Unlike textual tokens, EEG electrodes are spatially distributed across the scalp, raising the question of how electrode positions should be encoded in transformer-based EEG models. In this study, we benchmark five positional encoding strategies within the CBraMod backbone and evaluate them under linear probing and fine-tuning protocols on motor imagery classification and emotion recognition. Our results show that no single strategy consistently outperforms across tasks. Spherical Positional Encoding (SPE) yields strong representations for motor imagery but underperforms on emotion recognition, while Asymmetric Conditional Positional Encoding (ACPE) demonstrates more consistent performance across tasks. These findings suggest that the optimal positional encoding strategy is task-dependent, with no universal solution across EEG decoding scenarios.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统比较了5种给EEG电极位置编码的方法在Transformer模型中的效果，发现没有一种编码方式在所有脑电任务（运动想象、情绪识别）上都最优，任务不同应选不同编码策略。
analysis.claim: EEG变压器模型中不存在普适最优的位置编码策略，最优选择高度依赖具体解码任务。
analysis.input: 多通道原始EEG时序信号（含电极空间坐标）
analysis.output: 任务特定分类标签（如左手/右手运动想象、情绪类别）
analysis.robot_dependency: none
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开脑电数据集（如BCI Competition IV 2a、DEAP）
analysis.significance_reason: 纯方法论基准测试，无新模型架构/无真实闭环交互/无临床或具身部署价值；虽覆盖两个任务且含消融，但仍在传统监督式脑电分类框架内，未触及BCI领域核心瓶颈（如跨被试零样本泛化、在线自适应、神经反馈闭环），显著弱于所有参照基石工作（全部涉及实时闭环控制、高维输出生成或临床级功能恢复）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——是脑电信号处理子领域的扎实基准工作，但与具身智能/机器人方向无关，既不驱动动作生成也不连接物理执行器，对机器人感知-决策-行动闭环无实质贡献。

papers.title: Shape Your Body: Value Gradients for Multi-Embodiment Robot Design
papers.abstract: We propose to turn generalist multi-embodiment value functions into reusable models for robot design. Instead of running a new reinforcement learning co-design loop for each robot, we first train an embodiment-aware policy and value function across many robot designs. After training, the frozen value function is used as a differentiable surrogate to optimize candidate embodiments through value gradients. We evaluate our approach across different robot design settings, from perturbed single robots to held-out robots across morphology classes, with single models trained on up to 50 robots and design spaces of over 1100 continuous embodiment parameters. Beyond optimizing complete embodiments, we show that value gradients can identify performance-limiting design and control parameters, enabling both the optimization and the analysis of new robot designs.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出用预训练的多机体价值函数作为可微代理，通过反向传播价值梯度来优化机器人本体结构（如关节参数、连杆长度等），无需为每个新设计重新训练强化学习策略。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所
analysis.claim: 冻结的多机体价值函数可作为可微设计代理，其梯度能有效指导连续形态参数空间中的机器人本体优化与性能瓶颈分析。
analysis.input: 机器人形态参数向量（如连杆长度、质量、关节限位等）+任务目标（如行走速度、能耗约束）
analysis.output: 优化后的形态参数更新方向（即价值梯度）
analysis.robot_dependency: MuJoCo仿真器中自定义的14种以上腿式/轮式/双足机器人模型
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用仿真环境生成的策略 rollout 数据训练价值函数
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将价值函数显式用作可微设计代理并验证跨形态泛化能力，但全部实验限于仿真、无真实机体验证、未接入任何硬件闭环、未与现有工业设计工具链（如CAD/FEA）对接，属于扎实的算法层面增量，尚未触及机器人本体设计的实际工程门槛。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——方法新颖且在仿真中验证了跨形态梯度可用性，但离真实机器人设计落地极远，暂无法撼动任何一项基石系统（如Unitree G1或Figure 02）所代表的机械-控制-制造全栈能力。
