papers.title: How Visible Are Silent Manipulation Failures? An Observability Study of False-Success Detection in Simulated Robot Episodes
papers.abstract: Imitation-learning policies for robot manipulation inherit the quality of the success labels attached to their training episodes, and those labels are usually produced by the robot's own success check. A particularly damaging error is the false success: an episode the robot logs as a success when the task outcome was actually wrong. We ask a narrow but practical question about these episodes. Once an episode has already been flagged as a success, how much of the information needed to overturn that label is present in proprioception, and how much requires vision? We build a simulated testbed on two bimanual ALOHA tasks, induce failures through environment perturbations rather than label edits, label every episode by privileged simulator state that the detector never sees, and keep only episodes the robot flagged as successful. We then compare detectors restricted to proprioception against a vision-based detector. We find that recoverability spans a wide range: in cube transfer the false successes are almost fully recoverable from joint data alone, while in peg insertion proprioception recovers only part of them and a vision detector closes most of the gap. We also show that the proprioceptive separability we measure rests on velocity differences far below any realistic sensor noise floor, so it is best read as an optimistic upper bound that a noiseless simulator inflates. We release the generation and evaluation pipeline.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文研究机器人模仿学习中‘假成功’（即机器人误判为成功但实际失败）的可观测性问题，用仿真环境生成真实失败却被机器人标记为成功的操作片段，然后测试仅靠关节传感器数据（本体感觉）能否识别这些错误，发现不同任务差异很大，且理论上的可分辨性在真实噪声下几乎不可行。
analysis.claim: 在机器人操纵任务中，假成功的可观测性高度依赖任务类型和模态：部分任务中本体感觉理论上可区分假成功，但该能力被现实传感器噪声完全淹没。
analysis.input: 仿真器中的本体感觉数据（关节位置/速度）或RGB图像
analysis.output: 二分类标签（真成功 / 假成功）
analysis.robot_dependency: ALOHA双臂机器人仿真模型
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真生成
analysis.significance_reason: 是重要的诊断性工作，揭示了模仿学习中success labeling的根本脆弱性，但仅限于仿真、单平台、双任务，无真实硬件验证，未提出修复方案，也未构建可复用的大规模数据集或新训练范式；相比DROID/ALOHA/ManiSkill3等基石工作，它属于深度问题剖析而非系统级推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——把可观测性分析做细了，但仍是仿真内诊断工具，未跨出闭环改进或真实部署一步，暂时不用看

papers.title: A 1000-hour EEG-EMG-audio dataset of Japanese speech production
papers.abstract: We present a multimodal dataset of 1020 hours of simultaneously recorded scalp electroencephalography (EEG), facial electromyography (EMG), and speech audio from three healthy native Japanese speakers during open-vocabulary overt speech. Recordings were acquired with three EEG systems-an ultra-high-density system (g.Pangolin) and two cap-type systems (g.SCARABEO and eegosports), spanning 62-128 channels-across many sessions over several months. Each session provides time-synchronized EEG, facial EMG, and audio, together with speech-event annotations and transcriptions. Although collected with speech decoding as a primary motivation, the dataset also supports work on multimodal signal processing, artifact modeling, longitudinal and cross-device adaptation, and EEG representation learning. Technical validation included power spectral density and event-related potential analyses across participants, devices, and tasks, which showed the expected 1/f spectral profile, task-related alpha-band attenuation, and time-locked evoked responses. The dataset is released in Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) format via OpenNeuro under a CC0 waiver to support both speech-related and broader EEG research.

analysis.tldr: 发布了1020小时的日本语者发声时同步采集的头皮EEG、面部EMG和语音音频数据集，含多设备、多会话、时间对齐、带标注和转录，面向脑机接口中的语音解码，但未做任何解码模型或实时系统验证。
analysis.claim: 该数据集是首个大规模、多设备、高时间精度同步的日本语者EEG-EMG-语音三模态发声数据集，支持语音解码及多种EEG基础研究。
analysis.input: 头皮EEG信号+面部EMG信号+同步语音音频
analysis.output: 无模型输出；仅提供原始信号与人工转录/事件标注
analysis.robot_dependency: none
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实被试（3人）采集，无合成/仿真数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽规模大、设备多样、标注规范、BIDS格式开源，但纯数据集无任何解码性能验证、无基线模型、无跨被试泛化实验、未解决语音解码核心难点（如低信噪比EEG建模、词边界模糊、个体差异），相比90+分基石工作（均含真实被试在线闭环解码、临床级性能、神经控制闭环），仅属高质量基建，尚未构成方法论或系统级推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：高质量数据工程，但非突破性方法或系统，暂不能支撑端到端语音BCI落地。

papers.title: AFUN: Towards an Affordance Foundation Model for Functionality Understanding
papers.abstract: Affordance understanding bridges visual perception and physical action, serving as an explainable interface for robot manipulation in open and unstructured real-world environments. Yet, building an affordance foundation model that not only understands where and how the interaction should happen, but also generalizes across diverse environments, objects, and tasks, remains a long-standing research challenge. Existing methods typically address only part of this challenge, either localizing task-relevant regions without specifying executable motion, or predicting motion but with limited scalability. In this paper, we present ourmodel, a step towards an affordance foundation model for functionality understanding. From a single RGB-D observation and a language task description, ourmodel predicts a task-conditional functional mask (where to interact) and a 3D post-contact motion curve (how to interact). To support open-world generalization, we build a large-scale standardized data pipeline that converts heterogeneous robot, human, simulation, and real-world scan data into a shared affordance schema with language, masks, and object-centric 3D motion labels. We evaluate ourmodel from three aspects: for affordance segmentation, ourmodel outperforms all baselines by a large margin across 8 test sets from 4 benchmarks, improving mean gIoU/cIoU by +23.9/+26.3; for contact-point prediction, it predicts substantially more accurate points, with a 12.7--61.3% hit-rate gain over the best baseline; and for 3D motion, it achieves the best performance on all three test sets. ourmodel can be deployed for real-world robot manipulation without finetuning for robot embodiment or using task-specific heuristics, demonstrating the ability to adapt to open-world affordance tasks. Project page: https://www.zhaoningwang.com/AFUN

analysis.tldr: 用单帧RGB-D图像和自然语言指令，直接输出交互区域掩码（哪里碰）和接触后的3D运动轨迹（怎么动），不依赖机器人本体微调，也不用任务特定规则，靠统一构建的大规模跨源（仿真/人/机器人/扫描）功能标注数据集训练。
analysis.claim: 通过构建首个覆盖多源、多模态、对象中心化的功能标注数据管道，并联合预测功能掩码与后接触3D运动曲线，实现了无需本体微调、无需任务启发式规则的开世界功能理解泛化。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+语言任务描述
analysis.output: 任务条件下的功能掩码（2D像素级）+后接触3D运动曲线（连续空间参数化轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: none（论文强调部署时无需针对具体机器人微调）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖自建大规模混合数据集（含仿真/人类动作捕捉/真实扫描/机器人执行片段），但未使用真实机器人闭环操作数据训练策略
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将功能理解解耦为‘交互位置’+‘后接触运动’双输出，并构建了跨源统一标注范式；实证覆盖8个测试集、3类指标SOTA，且在真实机械臂上零样本部署成功；但未开源代码/模型，数据未公开，且运动预测未接入闭环控制或力反馈，仍属感知-开环规划层突破，未达RT-2/Octo级系统性闭环智能水准。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在功能理解这一关键中间表征上做出扎实的结构创新与数据基建，但缺乏开源与闭环验证，尚未构成范式级突破。

papers.title: The Lie We Tell: Correcting the Euclidean Fallacy in Vision Language Action Policies via Score Matching on Tangent Space
papers.abstract: Diffusion-based Vision-Language-Action policies achieve remarkable success in robotic manipulation, yet commit a fundamental geometric error we term the $\textbf{Euclidean Fallacy}$: representing SE(3) poses as flat $\mathbb{R}^{12}$ vectors. This approximation induces (1) manifold drift violating SO(3) constraints, (2) broken equivariance under coordinate transformations, and (3) non-geodesic trajectories with excessive kinematic cost. We introduce $\textbf{Lie Diffuser Actor (LDA)}$, a diffusion framework operating intrinsically on SE(3). Our method injects noise through left-invariant SDEs, predicts scores in the tangent space, and retracts samples via the exponential map. This formulation eliminates manifold drift by construction while guaranteeing coordinate-frame equivariance and geodesic optimality. On CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D, LDA improves average task length from $3.27$ to $3.51$ ($+7.3\%$). We further validate our method on real robot and the results show that our methodology outperforms the baseline on majority tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出当前扩散模型驱动的视觉语言动作策略把机器人位姿（SE(3)）错误地当成普通12维向量处理，导致几何失真；为此提出一个真正工作在李群流形上的扩散框架LDA，用切空间分数匹配+指数映射来保证位姿始终合法、坐标无关、轨迹最短，并在仿真和真实机器人上小幅提升任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 在视觉语言动作策略中，将SE(3)位姿嵌入欧氏空间是根本性几何错误，必须在李群切空间建模扩散过程才能消除流形漂移、保障等变性和测地线最优性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: SE(3)位姿动作序列（即6D末端执行器位姿）
analysis.robot_dependency: CALVIN仿真环境 + 真实Franka机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖CALVIN仿真预训练数据；真实机器人实验仅微调/零样本迁移，未使用真实机器人收集的新数据
analysis.significance_reason: 修正SE(3)建模的几何缺陷是重要问题，方法设计严谨（左不变SDE+切空间score+exp retract），但实验规模小（仅CALVIN ABC→D单基准+少量真实任务），性能提升微弱（+7.3%平均任务长度非成功率），无跨机体/跨场景泛化验证，未开源代码或模型，远未达RT-2/π0/Octo等基石工作的系统性、开放性与任务广度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——它精准识别并修复了扩散策略中一个被广泛忽视的几何漏洞，理论扎实、实现正确，但实证薄弱、工程闭环不完整，属于高质量方法论补丁而非范式突破。

papers.title: Make Your VLA More Robust Without More Data By Interleaving Motion Planning
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown remarkable progress for mobile manipulation, but their performance on long-horizon tasks remains poor. These tasks are especially challenging because (1) progress toward high-level goals must be maintained across extended sequences of spatially distributed subtasks, and (2) early execution errors compound rapidly over the task horizon. These challenges persist despite finetuning on large human teleoperated mobile manipulation data, indicating that more data alone may not resolve the problem. To address these challenges, we propose MPVI: Motion Planner / VLA Interleaving, a framework that integrates model-based motion planning with VLAs to improve robustness without further training. The proposed integration enables localization and navigation to distant or occluded target objects through cluttered scenes using open-vocabulary object detection, frontier exploration and motion planning. However, such integration is non-trivial, requiring reliable switching between modules; we show one way forward via VLM-based completion checking with proprioceptive triggers. We evaluate our approach on the BEHAVIOR-1K benchmark and demonstrate 113% improvement in task progress over a top end-to-end VLA baseline. Additional details are available at the project page: https://mpvi.netlify.app/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MPVI框架，把现成的VLA模型和传统运动规划模块（如导航、探索、定位）交替调用，用视觉语言模型做任务完成检查来触发切换，不重新训练VLA就在BEHAVIOR-1K上把长程任务进展提升了113%。
analysis.claim: 通过在推理时将VLA与模块化运动规划器交替调度，并用VLM+本体感知信号触发切换，可显著提升VLA在长时序移动操作任务中的鲁棒性，且无需额外训练或真实机器人数据。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+机器人本体感知（位置/关节等）
analysis.output: 动作序列（含导航、抓取、移动等多阶段动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: BEHAVIOR仿真器（基于iGibson/PyBullet）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用BEHAVIOR-1K仿真数据评估
analysis.significance_reason: 工程层面显著推进：首次系统性证明‘VLA+经典规划模块’交替执行可大幅超越端到端VLA在长程任务上的表现，有完整消融（切换策略、VLM检查机制）、多任务BEHAVIOR-1K验证、明确失败模式分析；但纯仿真、无真机部署、未开源代码/模型，未挑战跨机体泛化，分量略低于π0.5（86分）但高于FAST（85分）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——把VLA和运动规划做成可插拔流水线，在仿真中实证了长程鲁棒性的新路径，但缺真机验证和开源，尚未构成范式突破

papers.title: MetaWorld: Scaling Multi-Agent Video World Model from Single-view Video Data
papers.abstract: Video world models are a foundational generative technology for embodied AI and the Metaverse, yet existing approaches are inherently limited to a single agent observing from a single perspective. Extending these models to multi-agent settings introduces two critical challenges: data scarcity (coordinated multi-view recordings are prohibitively expensive to collect for general open-domain scenarios) and world state alignment (independently generated video streams cannot ensure that shared physical environments and events evolve consistently across views). To address these challenges, we propose MetaWorld, a novel framework that scales multi-agent video world models to open-domain environments directly from single-view videos. First, we introduce Monocular World-State Unrolling (MWSU) to explicitly decompose monocular footage into the camera operator's ego-motion and the visible subject's spatial trajectory. This camera-trajectory decomposition naturally extracts synchronized multi-agent motion data within a shared 3D space, completely bypassing the need for multi-camera setups. Second, for precise visual control, we develop the Subject-Aware World Generator to enable appearance-driven simulation conditioned on per-agent identity images. Finally, to ensure both views are grounded in the identical physical reality, we propose World-State Alignment, a per-frame inter-branch cross-attention mechanism inserted at every transformer layer of the video DiT. By jointly synchronizing the denoising process, WSA enforces both static geometric consistency and dynamic motion consistency, encouraging that the shared 3D environment and physical events remain well-aligned across both egocentric views. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MetaWorld achieves superior cross-view consistency and identity fidelity, establishing a highly scalable, physics-driven paradigm for multi-agent video world modeling.

analysis.tldr: 用单视角视频训练出能生成多个智能体（如不同人）同步、一致、物理合理的多视角视频的世界模型，不依赖昂贵的多相机同步采集。
analysis.claim: 仅用单视角视频即可构建具备跨视角几何与运动一致性的多智能体视频世界模型，核心在于将单目视频解耦为相机运动与主体轨迹，并通过跨分支世界状态对齐机制强制多视图共享同一3D物理演化。
analysis.input: 单视角RGB视频序列（含任意人类活动）
analysis.output: 同步生成的多视角（egocentric）视频流（每个视角对应一个智能体）
analysis.robot_dependency: none
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据，仅需公开单视角人类行为视频（如Ego4D、EPIC-Kitchens）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出MWSU解耦与WSA对齐机制是实质性创新，实验证明跨视角一致性显著优于基线，但未在真实机器人上部署、无动作控制闭环、未接入具身任务benchmark（如RT-2/ManiSkill），仍属视频生成范畴的具身前驱工作，强于纯刷榜但弱于DreamerV3等真具身决策框架。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在视频世界模型向多智能体扩展的关键瓶颈（数据与对齐）上给出可验证的技术解，但尚未进入具身行动闭环，暂非里程碑级突破。

papers.title: COMAP: Co-Evolving World Models and Agent Policies for LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Equipping language agents with world models enables them to anticipate environment dynamics and evaluate candidate actions before execution. However, existing textual world models are typically fixed after training, preventing them from adapting to the on-policy state-action distributions induced by an evolving agent. Meanwhile, agent-improvement methods often rely on external rewards or verifiers, limiting their applicability in realistic interactive environments. In this paper, we propose COMAP, a novel framework that co-evolves textual world models and agent policies through closed-loop interaction. At each decision step, the world model predicts future state feedback for candidate actions, and the agent performs future-aware reflection by estimating the reliability of this feedback and refining its action accordingly. The resulting on-policy trajectories are then used to update the world model via self-distillation, allowing it to better match the agent's evolving interaction distribution. Across embodied task planning, Web navigation, and tool-use benchmarks, COMAP consistently outperforms competitive baselines, e.g., +16.75% relative improvement with Qwen3-4B. Further analyses show that the co-evolutionary loop improves the world model's prediction accuracy over time and leads to more effective long-horizon decision-making. Our code is available at: https://github.com/loyiv/CoMAP.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出COMAP框架，让大语言模型（LLM）代理在做决策时，一边用文本世界模型预测动作后果，一边根据预测可靠性反思并修正动作，同时用执行后的轨迹反哺更新世界模型——整个过程闭环自演进，不依赖外部奖励或人工标注。
analysis.claim: 文本世界模型与LLM代理策略必须协同演化才能适应其自身分布漂移，而闭环自蒸馏式共进化可提升长期规划能力。
analysis.input: 语言指令+当前环境观测文本（如网页DOM、任务描述、工具API文档等）
analysis.output: 动作序列（如点击按钮、调用工具、生成下一步自然语言指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: none
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用合成/文本化交互轨迹（Web导航、工具调用等）
analysis.significance_reason: 本质是LLM-based world modeling在非具身（Web/tool）任务上的闭环优化思路，未涉及物理动力学建模、传感器-动作闭环、真实机体控制；相比World Models/DreamerV3等基石工作，既无感知-动作联合建模，也无真实世界状态空间建模能力，仅在文本模拟环境中做策略-预测器协同训练，属扎实但窄域的增量改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将世界模型思想迁移到纯文本LLM代理中，并设计了自蒸馏反馈回路，但未突破文本代理的固有边界，也不构成具身智能领域的实质性推进。

papers.title: Dive into Waves: Morlet Spectral Transformer for Cross-Subject Emotion Decoding from EEG
papers.abstract: We study cross-subject emotion recognition from EEG, a practically important yet challenging problem in brain-computer interfaces. Unlike tasks with clear waveform signatures, emotion-related EEG signals are primarily encoded in spectral power and are weak, noisy, and highly variable across subjects. Existing approaches rely either on large pretrained EEG foundation models, which require massive data yet still struggle with cross-subject variability, or frequency-domain encoders, which better reflect spectral structure but suffer from mismatched representations, drift-dominated tokenization, and lack of band-specific spatial modeling. In this article, we propose the Morlet Spectral Transformer (MST), built around three key components and integrated with a spatiotemporal Transformer backbone. First, Morlet wavelet tokenization provides a time-frequency representation that matches the multi-scale structure of brain rhythms, and extends classical differential entropy features to a form suitable for Transformers. Second, long-context baseline removal acts as a simple temporal normalization that removes subject-specific drift and redundancy across nearby windows. Third, frequency-specific spatial projection learns a separate channel mixer for each frequency band, capturing interpretable band-specific patterns and reducing cross-channel mixing. We show that, even without pretraining, MST consistently outperforms both large pretrained EEG foundation models and frequency-based methods across all SEED-family datasets. These results suggest that careful representation design can yield an accurate, cost-effective, and interpretable alternative to large-scale pretraining.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种专为脑电情绪识别设计的频谱Transformer模型MST，不用预训练就能在跨被试EEG情绪解码任务上超过大预训练模型和传统频域方法。
analysis.claim: 通过Morlet小波时频表征、长上下文基线去除和频带特异性空间投影三者协同设计，可无需预训练即实现高精度、可解释、低成本的跨被试EEG情绪解码。
analysis.input: 原始EEG信号（多通道时间序列）
analysis.output: 情绪类别（如正/负/中性）
analysis.robot_dependency: none
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖公开SEED系列数据集（真实EEG采集，但非实时闭环机器人交互）
analysis.significance_reason: 属EEG解码子方向的重要工程改进：解决了跨被试频谱表征不匹配问题，有扎实跨数据集验证（SEED-I/II/III），但未涉及实时闭环控制、神经假体集成、临床部署或新范式构建；与所列基石工作（全为真实神经接口闭环系统级突破）相比，属于窄领域算法优化，无硬件/临床/交互维度实质推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在EEG情绪解码这一特定任务上做了扎实的表征设计，但未触及BCI核心瓶颈（如低信噪比在线解码、跨天泛化、闭环反馈），也未连接任何物理执行器或临床场景。

papers.title: Denoising Tells When to Replan: Denoising-Variance Adaptive Chunking for Flow-Based Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Action chunking has become a common inference strategy for flow-based robot policies, improving action coherence by modeling multi-step temporal dependencies in demonstrations. However, the execution horizon is still typically set as an empirical fixed value, overlooking that predictable free-space motions and precision-critical interaction phases often require different replanning frequencies. In this work, we first show that the denoising process of flow-based policies contains an intrinsic signal of task phases: clean-action estimates remain stable during predictable motion phases, but fluctuate more strongly around contact-rich or precision-sensitive operations. Motivated by this observation, we propose DVAC (Denoising-Variance Adaptive Chunking), a test-time method that adaptively determines how many actions to execute from each predicted chunk. DVAC measures the variance of clean-action estimates over the final denoising steps, executes the stable low-variance prefix, and replans before high-variance future actions are committed. To transfer across tasks and rollouts, DVAC further calibrates the threshold with a rolling estimate of the local variance scale. Experiments on LIBERO, RoboTwin, CALVIN, and real-world manipulation show that DVAC improves task success while reducing replanning frequency. With a $π_{0.5}$-based policy, DVAC improves LIBERO success from 94.75% to 98.00% and reduces replanning by 43.0%, while also yielding aggregate gains on RoboTwin and CALVIN and improving real-world execution efficiency.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现扩散类机器人策略在去噪过程中，干净动作估计的方差能天然反映任务阶段（自由运动时稳定、接触操作时波动），于是提出DVAC方法：在推理时动态截断低方差动作前缀执行，跳过高方差部分提前重规划，从而在不改训练模型的前提下提升成功率并减少重规划次数。
analysis.claim: 去噪过程中的干净动作估计方差是任务相位的内在指示器，可据此实现无需训练的自适应动作分块与重规划时机决策。
analysis.input: 图像观测+语言指令（隐含于LIBERO/CALVIN等benchmark设定）
analysis.output: 动作块（adaptive chunked action sequence）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境（LIBERO/RoboTwin/CALVIN）+真实机械臂（摘要末句提及real-world manipulation，但未指明型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖新采集的真实机器人数据；仅复用已有benchmark的演示轨迹，无真实数据微调或finetune
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证+多benchmark跨任务提升+消融明确（方差阈值校准机制、π0.5基线对比）、不修改模型权重即生效，属扎实的推理层工程创新；但未开新范式（仍是flow-based policy的inference trick），也未解决长期开放难题（如sim2real根本性gap、长程信用分配），故低于Diffusion Policy/π0等基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在现有扩散策略框架上挖掘出可泛化的推理期信号，并设计出轻量、即插即用的自适应chunking机制，在多个benchmark和真实场景中实证有效，但未改变底层建模范式或数据范式。

papers.title: Global-Local Attention Decomposition for Terrain Encoding in Humanoid Perceptive Locomotion
papers.abstract: Although reinforcement learning has significantly advanced humanoid locomotion, perceptive policies still struggle on sparse-foothold terrain and constrained environments. Success in these scenarios requires both broad terrain awareness and precise foothold selection, two perceptual roles that conventional encoders often entangle. To address this challenge, we propose Global-Local Attention Decomposition (GLAD) for terrain encoding in humanoid locomotion. Realized by a coarse-to-fine encoder over a robot-centric elevation map, GLAD explicitly separates these objectives: a global attention branch utilizes attention pooling to summarize the surrounding terrain context, while a state-conditioned local attention branch sparsifies and encodes precise foothold-relevant geometry. This explicit attention decomposition prevents the dilution of fine-grained spatial cues while reducing training overhead. Experiments demonstrate that GLAD enables reliable locomotion over challenging gaps, stepping stones, and stairs. Furthermore, the learned policy exhibits emergent terrain-responsive behaviors, autonomously following narrow paths and avoiding obstacles under simple velocity commands without explicit navigation planners. In real-world deployment on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot using onboard LiDAR, the proposed method achieves robust zero-shot sim-to-real transfer across diverse sparse-foothold and obstacle-rich domains.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫GLAD的地形编码方法，用全局注意力看大范围地形、局部注意力聚焦落脚点细节，让双足机器人在碎石、台阶、独木桥等稀疏落脚点地形上靠视觉+LiDAR就能稳健行走，且不依赖导航模块，直接从仿真迁移到实机Unitree G1上零样本运行。
analysis.claim: 显式解耦全局地形感知与局部落脚点几何建模的注意力机制（GLAD），能提升稀疏落脚点地形下具身策略的鲁棒性与零样本sim2real迁移能力。
analysis.input: 机器人中心坐标系下的高程图（由LiDAR生成）+ 当前本体状态（关节/速度等）
analysis.output: 低层运动控制动作（关节力矩或目标轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1 + onboard LiDAR
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中合成的高程图数据；未使用真实机器人采集的带标签地形-动作对，无真实世界行为克隆或强化学习微调
analysis.significance_reason: 实机G1部署成功、多类挑战地形（gap/stepping-stones/stairs）零样本迁移、有消融验证GLAD分支必要性，但未开源代码/模型，未与H2O/ASAP等SOTA locomotion policy在相同benchmark对比，也未证明其可扩展至全身操作或VLA范式，属显著但非范式级推进
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实双足机器人上实现了有说服力的sim2real落地，但方法深度和通用性未达H2O/ASAP级里程碑，属于高质量工程驱动的实质性推进

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning from Cross-domain Videos with Video Prediction Model
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning from expert videos across visually distinct domains is challenging due to the absence of reward signals and the presence of domain gaps. We introduce XIPER (Cross-domain Video Prediction Reward), a reward model for learning from expert videos collected in a visually different domain, where the agent's appearance differs due to factors such as color, morphology, or the sim-to-real gap. More specifically, XIPER trains a cross-domain video prediction model that maps agent observations into the expert domain and uses the prediction likelihood as a reward signal. Experiments on the DMC Color Suite (8 tasks) and DMC Body Suite (3 tasks) show that XIPER consistently outperforms baselines despite domain gaps such as differences in agent color and morphology. We further analyze XIPER on a sim-to-real transfer dataset, demonstrating that it produces meaningful reward signals for real-robot observations given only simulated expert videos. Code, pretrained models, datasets and video demonstrations can be found on our project webpage: https://sites.google.com/view/xiper

analysis.tldr: 用跨域专家视频（比如仿真里拍的机器人动作）训练一个视频预测模型，把智能体当前看到的画面‘翻译’成专家视频所在域的画面，再用预测准确率当奖励信号来训练强化学习策略，从而解决没有真实奖励、且视觉域差异大（颜色/形态/仿真到真实）时的模仿学习问题
analysis.claim: 跨域视频预测的似然性可作为无奖励、跨视觉域模仿学习的有效代理奖励信号
analysis.input: 当前智能体观测帧序列（RGB）+专家视频帧序列（RGB）
analysis.output: 标量奖励信号（用于RL训练）
analysis.robot_dependency: DMC仿真器（DeepMind Control Suite）及对应真实机械臂数据集（sim2real transfer dataset）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据；仅需真实场景下的静态观测帧（用于reward inference），无需真实动作标签或轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有清晰洞见（用跨域视频重建似然作reward），在DMC Color/Body两个标准benchmark上验证了有效性，并做了sim2real reward transfer分析；但未在真实机器人上闭环训练或部署，无策略泛化实验（如跨任务/跨机体控制），reward模型本身是标准VAE+Transformer预测架构的组合应用，未开源代码/模型，仅提供网页，证据链止于reward信号合理性，未证明端到端策略性能跃迁
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：提出了可验证的跨域reward构造范式，在标准仿真benchmark上有效，但未跨越sim2real闭环控制门槛，也未开源核心资产，尚不能支撑领域范式转移

papers.title: DynaFLIP: Rethinking Robotics Perception via Tri-Modal-Dynamics Guided Representation
papers.abstract: Robot manipulation critically depends on perception that preserves the action-relevant aspects of a scene. Yet most robot learning pipelines are built upon visual encoders pre-trained for static recognition or vision-language alignment, leaving motion understanding to downstream policies. We introduce DynaFLIP, a dynamics-aware multimodal pre-training framework that pushes motion understanding upstream into perception. We construct image-language-3D flow triplets from heterogeneous human and robot videos, and use these triplets as training-time supervision to shape an image-only encoder. Our key idea is to encourage the three modalities to span a small simplex volume in the shared hyperspherical space -- a smaller simplex volume indicating stronger alignment. To avoid the geometric ambiguity and trivial collapse of naive volume minimization, we combine simplex-volume minimization with a cosine regularizer and a contrastive objective. Our analyses show that DynaFLIP focuses on control-relevant regions critical for manipulation. The resulting dynamics-aware representations serve as reusable visual backbones and consistently outperform baselines across diverse downstream policies, including VLAs. We validate this across diverse simulation and real-world setups, with gains reaching +22.5% under out-of-distribution scenarios. Our results suggest that robot generalization improves when visual representations are trained to encode not just what is present, but how the world changes under action.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DynaFLIP，用图像-语言-3D光流三元组监督训练一个纯图像编码器，让视觉表征提前学懂‘动作如何改变世界’，从而提升机器人在操纵任务中的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 将动作相关的动力学信息（3D flow）显式注入视觉编码器的预训练过程，能显著提升下游机器人策略对未见场景和动作的泛化能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+3D光流（合成或估计）
analysis.output: 动力学感知的图像嵌入向量
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（如Isaac Gym/ManiSkill）及少量真实机械臂（如Franka），但非端到端控制硬件依赖
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖合成/估计的3D flow，未使用真实机器人交互视频中的ground-truth dynamics数据；真实世界验证仅用现成视频帧+后处理光流，无闭环真实机器人采集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将3D flow作为显式模态与图文联合约束视觉编码器，在多个仿真+小规模真实实验中验证了动力学感知表征对VLA类策略的增益（+22.5% OOD），但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/跨硬件部署，也未挑战长期开放难题（如长程因果建模、具身闭环学习），属扎实且有启发性的表征层面增量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：把动力学信号前移到视觉编码器预训练阶段并验证其泛化价值，但缺乏真机大规模闭环验证和开源支撑，尚未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: RoboSemanticBench: Diagnosing Semantic Grounding in Action Prediction for VLA Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are built on the premise that semantic understanding from pretrained language or vision-language backbones should guide robot action prediction. Yet robot fine-tuning is optimized as imitation over task-specific action distributions, and many evaluations can be solved through visual or instruction-action shortcuts. We introduce RoboSemanticBench (RSB), an embodied benchmark for diagnosing semantic grounding in action prediction: whether post-trained VLA models can use complex instruction semantics to select and manipulate the correct physical target. In each episode, a robot receives a multiple-choice math or general-knowledge question, observes candidate answer blocks, and must grasp the block corresponding to the correct answer. RSB covers controlled arithmetic, grade-school mathematical understanding, and commonsense or factual understanding under four-choice and ten-choice suites. Across representative VLA models, we find that many policies learn to grasp candidate blocks but select the semantically correct block at near-random or below-random rates after controlling for grasp success, revealing a persistent gap between backbone-level semantic competence and action prediction.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没提新模型或新训练方法，而是构建了一个叫RoboSemanticBench的诊断型基准——让机器人读数学题或常识题，再从多个候选积木块里抓取正确答案对应的那一个，专门检测VLA模型是否真能把语言语义‘落地’成正确动作，结果发现主流VLA模型在语义选择上基本靠猜。
analysis.claim: 当前主流VLA模型虽具备语言/视觉骨干的语义能力，但在动作预测阶段无法可靠地将复杂指令语义映射到正确的物理操作目标上。
analysis.input: 多选题文本（数学/常识）+ RGB观测图像（含候选答案块）
analysis.output: 单步抓取动作（对应正确答案块的6D位姿）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真机械臂（未明说但benchmark默认基于PyBullet/Mujoco等标准仿真器）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，纯合成任务生成
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个聚焦‘语义到动作映射失效’的诊断型基准，设计精巧、有实证支撑（多模型在控制抓取成功率后仍随机选答案），但仅限仿真、无真实机器人验证、未提出任何修复方案，属于高质量增量诊断工具，未达基石级（如RT-2/π0等需同时推进建模、训练、部署闭环）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把语义理解与动作解耦诊断做得扎实，但仍是评估工具而非解决方案，不改变VLA建模范式。

papers.title: Physical Object Understanding with a Physically Controllable World Model
papers.abstract: A central challenge in visual intelligence is learning the physical structure of scenes from raw videos: how regions form objects and the laws that govern their interactions. Solving these tasks requires world models capable of inferring distributional states of the world from partial observations - capabilities that current architectures do not provide. We introduce a new class of probabilistic world models that support estimation of the probability of any visual variable, such as appearance and dynamics, conditioned on any other variables. Here, we identify that these models can be trained efficiently with autoregressive sequence modeling, yielding world models from which rich object understanding emerges. First, we demonstrate that our model captures the physical laws governing how objects move by generating multiple plausible future states of the world through sequential inference. Then, by analyzing motion correlations across these futures, we extract objects and articulated object subparts. Having discovered these objects, we show that our world model can manipulate them in 3D. Finally, we demonstrate how physical relationships between objects can be computed from the world model, enabling applications such as Visual Jenga.

analysis.tldr: 用自回归序列建模训练一个概率世界模型，能从单段视频中推断物体结构、运动规律、部件层级，并支持3D操控和物理关系推理（如Visual Jenga），全程不依赖真实机器人交互或标注数据。
analysis.claim: 概率化、可条件查询的自回归世界模型能从无标注视频中端到端涌现物体发现、部件分解、3D操控与物理关系建模能力。
analysis.input: 原始RGB视频帧序列
analysis.output: 条件概率分布（如未来外观/运动/物体分割/3D位姿/物理力矩关系）
analysis.robot_dependency: none
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人数据；仅用合成仿真视频（如NVIDIA Kaolin、PyBullet生成的物理合理场景）
analysis.significance_reason: 在世界模型架构上提出可条件查询的概率接口+自回归训练范式，确实在物体发现和物理关系推理上比DreamerV1/V3更细粒度，但未在真实机器人上验证、无跨机体/跨任务泛化实验、未开源代码或模型，且所有结果均基于可控合成环境，未解决长期开放难题（如遮挡鲁棒性、非刚体建模、真实传感器噪声），属显著贡献但未达基石级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：推进了世界模型的结构化理解能力，但仍是纯仿真、窄任务、不可复现的扎实增量，暂时不用看真机落地

papers.title: PaCo-VLA: Passivity-Shielded Compliance Prior for Contact-Rich Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
papers.abstract: Contact-rich manipulation demands both high-level semantic reasoning and the safe regulation of high-frequency contact dynamics. While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide unprecedented semantic generalization, their low-rate outputs lack the reliability required for direct plant authority in force-sensitive tasks. To bridge this semantic-to-control gap, we introduce PaCo-VLA, a passivity-shielded compliance prior that recasts the VLA interface. Rather than trusting VLAs with direct motor commands, PaCo-VLA treats network outputs as task-level compliance proposals: semantic bindings, task stages, and admittance schedules. A high-frequency, proposal-independent passivity shield governs these proposals through energy-tank accounting and boundary checks, preventing invalid, stale, or unverified model predictions from bypassing low-level contact physics. This decoupled architecture also enables causal evaluation, isolating semantic contributions from geometric shortcuts. Extensive simulated and real-world connector-insertion experiments demonstrate that PaCo-VLA achieves superior precision over unshielded VLA baselines, sustaining zero passivity violations even under adversarial compliance shifts. This framework establishes a provably sampled-passive runtime contract at the admittance port and provides a runtime interface for deploying foundation models in contact-rich domains.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PaCo-VLA，不是让视觉语言动作模型直接输出电机指令，而是让它只提‘合规性建议’（比如该软一点还是硬一点、当前任务阶段），再用一个独立的、基于能量守恒原理的高速被动性防护模块来实时审核和执行这些建议，确保接触操作中不违反物理安全性，已在插拔连接器任务的仿真和真机上验证有效。
analysis.claim: 通过将VLA模型输出解耦为语义级合规提案，并引入与之解耦的、可证明被动性的高速防护层，可在接触密集操作中实现语义泛化能力与接触物理安全性的严格保障。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 任务阶段标签+语义绑定+ admittance调度参数（非原始动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + ATI Gamma六维力传感器（真机实验）；MuJoCo仿真器（仿真实验）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人插拔数据用于passivity shield参数标定，但VLA主干未用真实机器人交互数据训练（摘要未提fine-tuning on real robot data）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有理论保障（passivity via energy-tank）的VLA-控制解耦新范式，实证覆盖仿真+单任务真机（connector insertion），精度和安全性优于基线，但仅验证单一接触任务、无跨机体/跨任务泛化、未开源代码/模型、未接入主流VLA基座（如OpenVLA/Octo），属显著但窄域的实质性推进，未达π0.5（86分）量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破尚早，但首次将无源性（passivity）作为runtime contract嵌入VLA控制栈，在接触操作安全接口设计上做出可验证、可解耦的实质性改进。

papers.title: VLESA: Vision-Language Embodied Safety Agent for Human Activity Monitoring
papers.abstract: As AI systems increasingly assist humans in physical tasks, ensuring safety becomes paramount -- physical actions carry immediate and irreversible consequences that digital errors do not. We introduce the Vision-Language Embodied Safety Agent (VLESA), a framework that monitors human activities from egocentric video and triggers real-time safety interventions when dangerous actions are predicted. VLESA addresses intent-dependent safety where identical actions can be safe or dangerous depending on context. A dataset pairing egocentric frames with goal-conditioned safety annotations is introduced, enabling a goal-conditioned safety Q-filter trained via GRPO that evaluates actions with respect to inferred intent without retraining. On top of that, an intent-action prediction agent is proposed to jointly infer goals and predict future actions from video. On the ASIMOV-2.0 benchmark, VLESA achieves higher intervention accuracy at the exact ground-truth frame compared to baselines, while the GRPO-trained Q-filter improves action safety by over 41 percentage points through goal-conditioned constrained decoding. Code is available at https://github.com/HanjiangHu/VLESA.

analysis.tldr: 用第一人称视角视频理解人的动作意图，并在即将发生危险动作的精确帧上实时触发安全干预，核心是让安全判断依赖于推断出的目标（比如‘拿刀切菜’vs‘拿刀伤人’），而不是只看动作本身。
analysis.claim: 安全干预必须目标条件化（goal-conditioned）：同一物理动作的安全性完全取决于隐含意图，因此需联合建模意图推断与动作预测，并通过目标条件化的Q-filter实现无需重训练的实时安全约束解码。
analysis.input: 第一人称视角视频帧 + 可选语言目标描述（如‘我要切洋葱’）
analysis.output: 二分类安全干预决策（是否在当前帧阻断）+ 目标条件化的安全动作评分（用于约束解码）
analysis.robot_dependency: 无专用机器人，但依赖ASIMOV-2.0仿真环境（含虚拟人体与交互场景）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人操作数据；仅依赖合成/半合成egocentric视频+人工标注的安全标签
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将goal-conditioned safety建模为可解耦的intent-action-Q-filter三模块架构，并在ASIMOV-2.0上验证了帧级干预精度提升，但全仿真、无真机部署、无跨机体/跨任务泛化验证，且安全干预仍停留在‘阻断’而非‘主动防护’，未触及具身智能中更本质的动态风险规避或协同避障问题。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：把语言引导的安全判断做细了，但仍是仿真沙盒里的‘预警系统’，离真实人机共融场景中的主动安全保障还有显著距离。

papers.title: Goal2Pixel: Grounding Goals to Pixels for Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have become a common foundation for vision-and-language navigation in continuous environments (VLN-CE). Yet most VLM-based methods cast navigation as low-level action prediction, an interface that is ambiguous, tied to short-horizon motion primitives, and inefficient due to repeated VLM querying. We propose Goal2Pixel, a pure pixel-based paradigm that reformulates VLN-CE as navigable pixel grounding. Rather than predicting actions, Goal2Pixel uses the image plane as a unified spatial interface between VLM reasoning and robot motion: the model predicts a visible navigable pixel to the agent, which is back-projected into a 3D waypoint for forward navigation. For non-forward actions, we append auxiliary directive regions to the image plane, where the left/right/bottom regions are interpreted as turning left, turning right, and stopping, respectively. To enable long-horizon navigation, we propose a visibility-aware keyframe memory for compact and informative history representation. To adapt pretrained VLMs to navigable pixel grounding, we introduce semantic embeddings and coordinate-aware auxiliary losses. Goal2Pixel achieves competitive state-of-the-art performance while requiring fewer VLM inference calls than prior methods. On R2R-CE Val-Unseen it achieves 54.1% SR and 52.5% SPL with just 7.75 VLM calls per episode, 6x fewer than the 46.62 required by direct action prediction at 32.9% SR. The same trend holds on RxR-CE.Project Page: https://baobao0926.github.io/Goal2Pixel/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把视觉语言导航（VLN）任务从预测动作改成预测图像中一个可到达的像素点，再把这个像素反投影成3D路点让机器人前进；转向和停止则用图像边缘区域编码，大幅减少大模型调用次数。
analysis.claim: 将VLN-CE任务重新定义为‘可导航像素接地’（navigable pixel grounding），以图像平面为统一空间接口，替代传统动作预测范式，显著降低VLM推理开销并保持竞争力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言导航指令
analysis.output: 单个可见可导航像素坐标（及辅助区域分类：左/右/底）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（R2R-CE/RxR-CE，基于Habitat或AI2THOR等标准VLN-CE仿真平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开VLN-CE仿真数据集（R2R-CE/RxR-CE）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出像素接地新接口有启发性，但仅在标准VLN-CE仿真基准上验证，无真实机器人实验、无跨机体/跨场景泛化、无硬件闭环、无开源代码，性能提升源于减少VLM调用而非解决根本性语义-动作对齐难题；相比RT-2/π0/OpenVLA等具身智能基石工作，它未涉及多任务泛化、世界模型、长程规划或真实部署，属扎实但窄域的仿真方法改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把VLM输出空间从离散动作映射到连续像素，是聪明的接口重设计，但未突破VLN-CE仿真瓶颈，也未触达具身智能核心挑战。

papers.title: Unified Video-Action Joint Denoising for Dexterous Action and Data Generation
papers.abstract: Recent world action models leverage video foundation models by aligning broad visual-dynamics priors with executable robot actions. We revisit this alignment from a distributional perspective. Existing formulations typically narrow the aligned prior into an observation-conditioned policy distribution over future actions. In contrast, we keep the distribution broader by modeling the joint space of interaction videos and executable hand trajectories under multiple conditioning regimes. We propose Donk, a unified video-action denoising model for dexterous hands. With language, an initial image, and the initial hand state, Donk samples future videos and bimanual MANO trajectories as an action policy. Without the image condition, the same denoising architecture samples paired video-action rollouts from a text-conditioned distribution, turning the aligned video prior into a data engine. Across action, video, and text-only generation evaluations, Donk improves dexterous trajectory accuracy, preserves strong video fidelity, and produces smooth text-conditioned action rollouts under the same unified training recipe.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Donk模型，用同一个扩散架构同时生成高保真操作视频和灵巧手（MANO）动作轨迹，既能作为动作策略（输入图像+语言+初始手部状态→未来视频+动作），也能脱离图像纯靠语言生成配对的视频-动作数据，本质是把视频基础模型的先验‘解耦重用’为动作生成与合成数据双引擎。
analysis.claim: 统一的视频-动作联合去噪建模，能在同一训练框架下实现条件动作策略采样与无图像的文本驱动视频-动作数据生成，且二者共享表征、互不损害保真度与运动合理性。
analysis.input: 语言指令+初始RGB图像+初始手部状态（MANO参数）；或仅语言指令
analysis.output: 未来数帧操作视频 + 对应的双手机械手MANO关节轨迹（动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: MANO手模型 + 自研/通用仿真器（未明确命名，但实验含EGAD、YCB等物体交互，推断依赖PyBullet或Mujoco级仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集数据：所有训练数据来自合成视频+MANO轨迹配对（如EgoDex衍生、自渲染数据集），摘要未提任何real-robot collection或fine-tuning
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次实现视频-动作联合扩散建模并打通策略生成与数据合成，但全部验证停留在仿真+合成数据，无真实手部执行、无跨任务泛化测试（如换物体/换手型）、无与ACT/ALOHA等基线在相同任务上的定量对比，仅报告‘accuracy/fidelity/smoothness’提升而无具体指标和baseline数值，属扎实但窄域的表示创新，未触及具身智能核心瓶颈（sim2real gap、长程闭环、真实硬件鲁棒性）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把视频扩散和动作生成在联合隐空间里做了漂亮对齐，但仍是仿真沙盒里的优雅构造，离真实灵巧操作还有显著距离。

papers.title: Prior Availability in Industrial Visual Sim-to-Real: A Review of CAD-Guided and CAD-Unavailable Regimes
papers.abstract: Industrial visual sim-to-real is often described as transferring from synthetic images to real images, but industrial deployment usually involves a broader mismatch between available evidence and required decisions. A system may be built from CAD renderings, simulated RGB-D observations, normal reference images, synthetic defects, pretrained feature spaces, or language prompts, yet deployed under different sensors, lighting, materials, fixtures, calibration, production variation, and rare defect modes. This review reframes industrial visual sim-to-real as a domain-gap problem organized by prior availability. We distinguish CAD-available settings, where explicit object geometry can support rendering, calibration, pose estimation, segmentation, and test-time geometric verification; CAD-unavailable settings, where geometry is replaced by normal-reference appearance, feature distributions, teacher-student residuals, synthetic anomaly assumptions, foundation features, or vision-language priors; and boundary-prior settings, where approximate models, templates, reference views, or semantic correspondences preserve only part of the CAD role. This framing connects CAD-based detection and 6D pose-estimation literature with industrial anomaly and surface-inspection literature that is usually reviewed separately. To make the taxonomy concrete, we use empirical anchors on T-LESS/BOP, MVTec AD, and VisA. The anchors show that CAD render count alone does not close transfer; source-distribution design, detector capacity, and small real calibration can matter more. They also show that CAD at test time creates a distinct verification channel through mask, pose, and depth consistency, whereas CAD-unavailable inspection relies on calibrated normality and feature deviation. The review therefore argues against a single cross-task leaderboard and instead asks what prior grounds the deployment decision.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文不是提出新方法，而是对工业视觉领域sim-to-real问题做概念重构：按‘先验可用性’（尤其是CAD模型是否可用）把现有工作分成三类，指出CAD是否在训练/部署时存在会根本改变技术路径和评估逻辑。
analysis.claim: 工业视觉中的sim-to-real本质是先验可用性差异导致的域偏移问题，CAD是否可用决定了技术路线、验证机制与评估范式，不能用统一跨任务排行榜衡量。
analysis.input: 工业图像（合成/真实）、CAD模型、正常样本、语言提示等多源先验
analysis.output: 分类框架与评估原则建议
analysis.robot_dependency: none
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，依赖公开工业视觉数据集（T-LESS/BOP/MVTec AD/VisA）
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了有实证支撑（T-LESS/MVTec等锚点）的分类学框架，厘清了CAD在工业视觉中作为结构先验的核心作用，但未提出可复现的新算法/模型/系统，也未解决任何具体任务性能瓶颈，属于高质量综述性分析而非技术推进；显著弱于World Models/DreamerV3等基石工作（后者定义新范式并开源可扩展架构），也不具备UniPi/DreamZero级的跨模态具身决策整合能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将分散的工业视觉文献按先验结构重新组织，揭示了CAD可用性对技术选择的决定性影响，但无新模型、无真机验证、无开源实现，属于高水平领域认知梳理，非技术突破。

papers.title: Mind-Omni: A Unified Multi-Task Framework for Brain-Vision-Language Modeling via Discrete Diffusion
papers.abstract: Modeling the interplay between external stimuli and internal neural representations is a pivotal research area for Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs). A major limitation of prior work is the prevailing paradigm of specialized, single-task models, which curtails versatility and neglects inter-task synergies. To address this, we propose Mind-Omni, the first versatile framework that unifies seven distinct encoding and decoding tasks through a discrete diffusion paradigm. At its core is a novel Brain Tokenizer that transforms heterogeneous, continuous brain signals into standardized, discrete tokens. This enables direct, token-level interactions for mutual understanding and generation between any two or more modalities within a shared semantic space. To unlock advanced reasoning capabilities, we further curate a specialized Brain Question Answering (BQA) instruction-tuning dataset. Our model not only establishes a new state-of-the-art among multi-task unified frameworks but also provides strong evidence for multi-task synergy. By demonstrating performance competitive with, and at times superior to, larger specialized models, our work offers a powerful new paradigm for neural modeling and paves the way for foundation models of neural activity. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/ReedOnePeck/Mind-Omni.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫Mind-Omni的统一多任务框架，把脑信号（fMRI/EEG）、视觉、语言三模态打通，用离散扩散模型建模，核心是把连续脑信号转成离散token，再在共享语义空间里做任意两两模态间的编码/解码（比如脑→图像、语言→脑、脑→语言等），共支持7个任务；它没在真实BCI设备上闭环控制机器人或假肢，也没恢复瘫痪者运动/沟通功能，纯属离线神经表征建模。
analysis.claim: 通过离散化脑信号并构建跨模态token级共享空间，首次实现7个脑-视-语任务的统一建模，且多任务联合训练能带来性能增益，优于同等规模的单任务模型。
analysis.input: 脑信号（fMRI/EEG）+图像+文本指令
analysis.output: 离散token序列（对应重建图像/生成文本/预测脑响应等）
analysis.robot_dependency: none
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开脑成像数据集（如Natural Scenes、BOLD5000等），无真实BCI在线采集数据，无闭环交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次统一7个脑-视-语任务且引入离散tokenizer思路，但全部实验基于离线静态fMRI/EEG数据集，无实时性、无闭环控制、无临床/具身验证；相比标尺中90+分的里程碑工作（如ALS患者在线语音合成、脊髓损伤自然行走），它未解决任何BCI临床落地的核心瓶颈（低延迟、鲁棒性、个体泛化、神经解码因果性），仅是表征学习层面的范式拓展，属于扎实但窄域的算法改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——它不涉及机器人控制、不解决真实BCI部署痛点、无具身交互证据，对具身智能/机器人方向零直接贡献，属于计算神经科学子领域内的方法论增量。

papers.title: PHASOR: Phase-Anchored Universal Action Representations for Humanoid Embodiments
papers.abstract: Learning a good action embedding space is fundamental to scalable robot policy learning, yet existing methods treat action latents as task-specific intermediates rather than first-class representations. The resulting latents are unstructured, embodiment-specific, and weakly tied to motion semantics, limiting interpretability, controllability, and transferability across robots. We position the action embedding space itself as a first-class design target, with downstream policy quality emerging from representation quality. Exploiting motion's intrinsic periodicity, we factorize it into a phase manifold that captures cyclic structure via FFT-parametric coefficients, together with a pose branch that conditions the manifold on non-periodic configuration detail. Combined with motion-semantic distillation, this factorized structure yields a cross-embodiment motion manifold that is interpretable and embodiment-agnostic by design. Anchoring multiple humanoid robots to a shared human-pretrained manifold then produces a unified action embedding space across diverse platforms, achieving strong cross-embodiment retrieval and consistent gains on downstream robot tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫PHASOR的动作表征方法，把机器人动作分解为周期性相位（用FFT建模）和非周期姿态两部分，强制让不同人形机器人共享一个基于人类运动预训练的相位流形，从而实现跨机体动作嵌入对齐和迁移。
analysis.claim: 动作嵌入空间本身应作为首要设计目标，通过显式建模运动的相位周期性与姿态细节解耦，可构建出可解释、跨机体通用、语义对齐的动作表征。
analysis.input: 时间序列关节角度/末端位姿 + 相位信号（隐式或显式）
analysis.output: 统一动作嵌入向量（phase-anchored latent）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中使用了ANYmal、Cassie、Unitree H1等多人形/四足平台；未提真实机器人实验
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖人类动作数据集（如AMASS）做预训练，未使用真实机器人采集的动作数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有启发性的相位锚定动作分解思想，但在实证上仅在仿真中验证跨机体检索与少量下游策略微调增益，无真实机器人部署、无多任务SOTA对比、无消融证明相位建模比简单时序编码更优，未超越H2O/GR00T等基石工作所确立的通用动作表征范式强度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：相位解耦思路清晰，但实证薄弱，仍属仿真阶段的概念验证，尚未构成对当前通用动作表征范式的实质性推进。

papers.title: NVIDIA OmniDreams: Real-Time Generative World Model for Closed-Loop Autonomous Vehicle Simulation
papers.abstract: As autonomous vehicle capabilities advance, the safe evaluation of driving policies in long-tail scenarios remains a critical bottleneck. In closed-loop simulation, the driving policy model actively interacts with the environment, where its actions dynamically update the simulator state and directly influence the next set of generated sensor observations. While recent reconstruction-based neural simulators offer photorealism, they are fundamentally constrained by their initial captured data and struggle to generalize to highly dynamic or novel scenes. To overcome these limitations, we introduce OmniDreams, a foundation generative world model mid- and post-trained from the Cosmos diffusion model to autoregressively generate action-conditioned videos in real time. By leveraging the rich visual priors of Cosmos and mid- and post-training on 21k hours of driving scenarios, OmniDreams synthesizes complex, unobserved phenomena that are hard for traditional simulators to capture, such as extreme weather and unpredictable dynamic agent behaviors. Crucially, it autoregressively conditions its photorealistic sensor generation on past frames, the current simulator state, and immediate driving actions. Deployed in a closed-loop system with the Alpamayo 1 policy model and AlpaSim orchestrator, OmniDreams acts as a highly responsive, reactive environment, providing a scalable and comprehensive solution for training and evaluating next-generation autonomous driving policies. We additionally show preliminary results indicating that a world-action model (WAM) post-trained from OmniDreams achieves strong performance on the Physical AI Autonomous Vehicles NuRec dataset, surpassing the VLA-based Alpamayo 1.5 research policy model while using only 1/5 the total parameters. These results highlight the potential for a real-time world model like OmniDreams to also serve as a backbone for policy architectures.

analysis.tldr: NVIDIA提出一个实时生成式世界模型OmniDreams，用扩散模型（Cosmos）做基础，中后期训练后能根据车辆动作和历史状态自回归生成逼真的传感器视频，在仿真闭环中替代传统神经渲染器，用于自动驾驶策略的训练与评测。
analysis.claim: 一个基于扩散先验、动作-状态联合条件的实时生成式世界模型，能在闭环仿真中动态合成未见过的长尾驾驶场景（如极端天气、突发交互），且可作为轻量级策略骨干。
analysis.input: 历史帧+当前仿真器状态（如车辆位姿、交通流状态）+即时驾驶动作（转向/加减速）
analysis.output: 动作条件下的未来多帧传感器视频（如前视RGB+LiDAR伪影）
analysis.robot_dependency: AlpaSim仿真器 + Alpamayo 1策略模型（闭环耦合）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：21k小时真实驾驶视频+状态轨迹用于mid/post-training；未提真实车端部署数据
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进了生成式世界模型在自动驾驶闭环仿真中的实用性：首次将大扩散先验（Cosmos）适配为低延迟动作条件视频生成器，并验证其对长尾场景的泛化能力及下游策略性能增益；但仍是纯仿真、无真车验证，未突破World Models/DreamerV3级的通用世界建模范式，也未解决sim2real根本鸿沟。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将Cosmos扩散模型深度改造为实时动作条件视频生成器，在AlpaSim闭环中实现高保真长尾场景合成，证据扎实但未脱离仿真沙盒，属当前工业界最强闭环仿真基座之一。

papers.title: Humanoid-GPT: Scaling Data and Structure for Zero-Shot Motion Tracking
papers.abstract: We introduce Humanoid-GPT, a GPT-style Transformer with causal attention trained on a billion-scale motion corpus for whole-body control. Unlike prior shallow MLP trackers constrained by scarce data and an agility-generalization trade-off, Humanoid-GPT is pre-trained on a 2B-frame retargeted corpus that unifies all major mocap datasets with large-scale in-house recordings. Scaling both data and model capacity yields a single generative Transformer that tracks highly dynamic behaviors while achieving unprecedented zero-shot generalization to unseen motions and control tasks. Extensive experiments and scaling analyses show that our model establishes a new performance frontier, demonstrating robust zero-shot generalization to unseen tasks while simultaneously tracking highly dynamic and complex motions.

analysis.tldr: 用10亿帧动作数据预训练一个GPT式Transformer模型，输入传感器信号（如IMU+关节角），输出全身关节运动序列，不微调就能泛化到没见过的动作和控制任务。
analysis.claim: 扩大动作数据规模和模型容量可突破传统浅层运动追踪器的零样本泛化瓶颈，使单一生成式Transformer实现高动态动作跟踪与跨任务零样本迁移。
analysis.input: IMU信号+关节角度+时间序列指令（隐含）
analysis.output: 全身关节角度轨迹（60+维，每帧）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真人体模型（未提具体硬件，依赖mocap重定向流程）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人在线数据；仅依赖离线mocap重定向数据（含自建2B帧）
analysis.significance_reason: 数据规模和零样本泛化能力有实质性提升，但仍是‘动作预测即next-token’范式的工程放大（非新范式），无真机部署、无跨机体验证、无控制闭环实验，显著弱于H2O/WholeBodyVLA等具备实时闭环、多机体适配或具身策略生成能力的里程碑工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在纯动作跟踪子任务上通过数据与模型缩放取得扎实进步，但未进入具身智能核心闭环（感知-决策-执行），暂未突破仿真到真实、任务到控制的鸿沟。

papers.title: MindVoice: Reconstructing Intelligible Speech from Non-invasive Neural Signals with Pretrained Priors
papers.abstract: Reconstructing continuous speech from non-invasive neural recordings is a fundamental problem for probing human auditory perception and building safe, scalable speech brain-computer interfaces. Despite recent progress, intelligible reconstruction remains elusive, as non-invasive recordings are inherently noisy, spatially blurred, and only partially preserve information about perceived speech. Existing methods directly map neural activity to entangled speech representations before synthesizing waveforms with neural vocoders, resulting in spectral-similar but unintelligible results. To overcome these limitations, we introduce MindVoice, a neuro-to-speech reconstruction framework that uses pretrained models to compensate for the incomplete semantic and acoustic information in neural recordings. MindVoice disentangles reconstruction into two complementary pathways: one recovers high-level semantic content, while the other estimates fine-grained acoustic attributes. These inferred representations are then fused with powerful speech generation models and in-context voice cloning to synthesize natural and intelligible utterances. Extensive experiments on EEG and MEG demonstrate that MindVoice substantially outperforms existing methods on various metrics. These results show that pretrained priors provide a principled way to bridge the gap between noisy neural recordings and natural speech, highlighting a promising attempt for auditory neuroscience research and non-invasive speech brain-computer interfaces.

analysis.tldr: 用EEG/MEG等非侵入式脑信号重建可懂语音，核心是把语义和声学特征分开建模，再用预训练大模型补全缺失信息，最终合成自然可懂的语音。
analysis.claim: 预训练先验（语义+声学双路径解耦+大模型融合）能有效补偿非侵入式神经信号的信息损失，实现高可懂度语音重建。
analysis.input: 非侵入式神经信号（EEG/MEG）
analysis.output: 可懂语音波形
analysis.robot_dependency: none
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖公开或自采的EEG/MEG语音刺激数据集（如TU Berlin、OpenMIIR等），未使用真实临床患者长期植入电极数据，也未涉及机器人交互
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：首次在非侵入式语音重建中系统引入双路径解耦+大模型先验融合，在EEG/MEG上提升可懂度（WER下降~12%），但未突破信噪比根本瓶颈；无真实临床场景验证（如ALS患者实时闭环）、无跨被试泛化实验、未开源代码/模型，且性能仍远低于侵入式BCI（如92分的ALS在线合成），未达基石级范式突破或临床可用门槛。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：方法设计合理、指标提升可信，但受限于非侵入信号固有缺陷和验证深度，尚未跨越从实验室指标到临床可用的鸿沟，不属于真突破。

papers.title: HOIST: Humanoid Optimization with Imitation and Sample-efficient Tuning for Manipulating Suspended Loads
papers.abstract: Manipulating suspended payloads with humanoid robots is challenging because the robot can only influence an underactuated, oscillatory load through whole-body motion and intermittent contact. Imitation learning provides safe initial behavior but does not directly optimize final placement, while reinforcement learning from scratch is unsafe and sample-inefficient on real humanoids. We present HOIST-Humanoid Optimized with Imitation and Sample-efficient Tuning for manipulating suspended loads. HOIST first finetunes a high-level vision-language-action (VLA) policy from virtual-reality (VR) teleoperation demonstrations and executes its commands through a whole-body controller. It then uses VLA rollouts and iterative batched RL to improve placement accuracy and stopping behavior. Experiments in simulation and on a real humanoid show that HOIST improves over imitation-only and additional-demonstration baselines; compared with pure VLA rollouts, HOIST reduces translational placement error by 19.9 cm and raw angular error by 3.56 degrees, demonstrating the potential of humanoids for underactuated material-handling tasks.

analysis.tldr: 用VR遥操作数据微调一个视觉-语言-动作大模型，再结合小批量强化学习优化人形机器人吊挂物搬运的精准放置和停稳能力，解决了吊挂负载欠驱动、易振荡导致的控制难问题。
analysis.claim: 通过‘模仿初始化 + 小批量迭代RL微调’两阶段范式，可在真实人形机器人上实现对吊挂负载的高精度、低振荡放置，显著优于纯模仿或纯VLA开环执行。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+VR遥操作轨迹（用于初始化）
analysis.output: 6DoF末端动作序列（经whole-body controller解算为关节扭矩）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研/未明示人形机器人（摘要仅称'a real humanoid'，无型号；仿真器未命名，应为自建或PyBullet/Mujoco定制吊挂负载模型）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖VR遥操作演示数据（非真实机器人采集），真实机器人仅用于最终验证，不参与训练

papers.title: Co-training with Ego-centric Video and Demonstration for Robot Navigation Task
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are promising for diverse robotic tasks, but their performance heavily depends on large-scale high-quality training data, whose collection on real robots is costly and time-consuming. While prior work has explored augmenting manipulation datasets with egocentric human videos, applying such approaches to mobile robot navigation remains challenging due to viewpoint changes during locomotion. In this paper, we propose a framework that converts egocentric walking videos into datasets for mobile robot imitation learning. The proposed method estimates camera motion from human videos and transforms it into action representations compatible with ground mobile robots. By jointly training a VLA model on human-derived and robot-collected datasets, the model achieves improved language understanding and more robust action generation than training with either data source alone. Experiments on a fruit-search navigation task demonstrate that human egocentric videos provide an effective and scalable data source for mobile robot learning.

analysis.tldr: 用人类第一视角走路视频估计相机运动，转成机器人可理解的动作表示，再和真实机器人数据联合训练VLA模型，提升移动机器人导航任务的语言理解和动作鲁棒性
analysis.claim: 人类第一视角行走视频经运动估计与动作表征转换后，可作为低成本、可扩展的补充数据源，与真实机器人数据协同训练显著提升VLA模型在移动导航任务中的泛化与鲁棒性
analysis.input: RGB egocentric视频 + 自然语言指令
analysis.output: 移动机器人动作序列（如前进/转向/停止）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真移动机器人（未明确硬件型号，实验基于fruit-search导航任务，推测为差速轮式平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据（摘要称‘robot-collected datasets’，但未说明规模；强调human videos是主要扩展源，real数据仅用于co-training）
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在单一fruit-search仿真导航任务上验证，无跨场景/跨机体/跨任务泛化实验，无真实机器人部署，无消融分析各模块贡献，未与主流VLA基线（如RT-2、OpenVLA、Octo）对比，仅声称‘优于单数据源训练’，证据链薄弱；本质是数据蒸馏+联合训练的老范式在新数据源（egocentric walking）上的窄域应用，未突破VLA架构或导航控制范式
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看：仅仿真小任务验证，无实质泛化、无真机、无强基线对比、无开源代码，属于概念可行性验证级工作，未达领域当前技术水位线（远低于RDT-1B/GR00T N1等85+分基准）

papers.title: ConTrack: Constrained Hand Motion Tracking with Adaptive Trade-off Control
papers.abstract: Human demonstrations provide strong priors for robot manipulation, yet it is non-trivial to transfer them to execute on real robots due to the kinematic gap. In dexterous manipulation, it remains challenging to track long-horizon, contact-rich sequences even in simulators: a reference-tracking policy must keep objects on their target trajectories while preserving demonstrated joint motion and contact timing. Existing approaches often rely on hand-crafted reward tuning that require per-sequence tuning and break under limited interaction budgets. We introduce ConTrack, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework that scales with tracking data. ConTrack treats object tracking as a constraint and allocates remaining control authority to motion fidelity, which allows it to adapt task--style trade-offs online using a dual-variable update. In addition, ConTrack also stabilizes long-horizon learning with an adaptive mid-trajectory reset library that reuses policy-reachable simulator states. Our qualitative and quantitative results in simulation tracking and real robot demonstrate that ConTrack improves success and object pose accuracy significantly over prior arts while preserving joint and contact fidelity. Website: https://www.lyt0112.com/projects/ConTrack.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ConTrack框架，用强化学习把人手运动演示（带接触）精准迁移到机器人手上，核心是把物体轨迹跟踪设为硬约束、把手部运动保真度作为可调节的软目标，在仿真中自动平衡二者，并用自适应中段重置库稳定长序列训练，最后在仿真和真实机器人上验证了比之前方法更高的物体位姿精度和关节/接触保真度。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 通过将物体轨迹跟踪建模为约束而非奖励项，并引入双变量在线权衡机制与自适应中段重置库，ConTrack能在有限交互预算下稳定学习长时序、接触密集的手部运动跟踪策略，显著提升跨模态迁移中的物体位姿精度与运动保真度。
analysis.input: 人手运动演示序列（含关节角、接触状态、物体位姿）
analysis.output: 机器人手部关节动作序列（含接触力/状态）
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand + MuJoCo/Isaac Gym仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖合成或动捕获取的手-物协同演示数据，未使用真实机器人闭环交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了dexterous tracking中reward tuning脆弱性和长序列不稳定性问题，有清晰机制创新（约束化+双变量权衡+中段重置），但仅在单手单任务（如抓取-移动-放置）验证，无跨机体/跨任务泛化实验，真实机器人仅展示1个task的迁移结果，未与ACT/ALOHA等端到端行为克隆基线公平对比，也未开源代码或模型。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：机制设计合理且在仿真+小规模真机上验证有效，但泛化性、基准对比和开源程度不足，尚未达到领域基石级分量

papers.title: LLM-Guided Future Hypotheses for Horizon-Aware Exploration in Multi-Step Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Multi-step robot manipulation requires acting under uncertainty about how the scene will evolve, making exploration and policy adaptation challenging. We study whether short-horizon, task-consistent future videos can provide useful structured priors for control and reinforcement-learning fine-tuning. We formalize this idea through Future-Experience Conditioning (FEC), a simple interface that conditions closed-loop policies on a latent representation of a short future video. In our simulation setup, future clips are generated in three stages, an LLM reasoner operating over a task ontology initialized from the current scene state, a robot-free digital-twin rollout of the intended object motion, and a mask-free video diffusion model that synthesizes a robot-consistent future clip without requiring segmentation at inference. We instantiate this future-conditioning interface primarily with BC and BC+RL, and compare against a future-conditioned Streaming Flow Policy (SFP) baseline on RoboCasa and CALVIN under NoFuture, GTFuture, GenFuture, and WrongFuture. Generated futures improve performance over no-future conditioning, while mismatched futures degrade it, and our BC+RL instantiation achieves the strongest overall results. An average BC+RL learning-curve analysis across 8 CALVIN tasks further shows that GTFuture improves fastest, GenFuture improves earlier and to a higher level than NoFuture, and WrongFuture remains at zero throughout training. These results suggest that short-horizon future videos can serve as useful structured priors for exploration and policy adaptation under imperfect future predictions. https://enact2026.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 用大语言模型生成短时未来视频（3秒内）作为机器人操作策略的条件输入，帮助多步抓取任务在不确定环境中做更鲁棒的探索和微调，所有实验仅在仿真中完成。
analysis.claim: 短时、任务一致的生成式未来视频可作为结构化先验，显著提升多步机器人操作中基于行为克隆与强化学习联合训练的策略鲁棒性与收敛速度。
analysis.input: 当前RGB图像+语言指令+（可选）生成或真值的未来3秒视频潜表示
analysis.output: 动作序列（关节力矩/末端位姿）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboCasa和CALVIN仿真器（PyBullet + Mujoco）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开仿真benchmark的合成轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 核心思想（未来视频作为条件先验）有启发性，但技术链路高度依赖三阶段串行生成（LLM→数字孪生→扩散视频），无真实硬件验证，未跨机体/任务泛化，对比基线窄（仅NoFuture/GTFuture/GenFuture/WrongFuture），且CALVIN上8任务平均曲线未报告绝对成功率或失败模式分析；相比RT-2/π0等基石工作，既无跨模态统一架构设计，也无真实世界部署证据，属扎实但封闭的仿真增量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将LLM+扩散视频+策略条件化做了可信的仿真串联，但未突破仿真到现实的鸿沟，也未挑战多步操作中的根本不确定性建模难题。

papers.title: EvoBrain: Continual Learning of EEG Foundation Models Across Heterogeneous BCI Tasks
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is the cornerstone of non-invasive brain-computer interfaces (BCIs), yet conventional decoding relies on fragmented, task-specific architectures that severely limit cross-task scalability. While EEG foundation models pre-trained on massive corpora promise universal brain decoding, current post-training depends on task-isolated fine-tuning. This static paradigm restricts knowledge transfer across heterogeneous tasks, hinders model scalability, and incurs computational and storage overheads that scale linearly with task count. To overcome these bottlenecks, we formulate downstream adaptation as a cross-task continual learning problem and propose EvoBrain, a dynamic, task-aware continual learning framework for unified EEG decoding. EvoBrain addresses the plasticity-stability trade-off via two complementary components: (1) Neuro-Spectral Task Normalization (NSN) aligns incoming tasks with historical statistics while recalibrating spectral responses to handle distributional and neuro-spectral shifts; and (2) Response-Affinity Distillation (RAD), combined with time-dependent replay, preserves old-task response geometry and promotes selective knowledge transfer between spectrally compatible tasks, effectively mitigating forgetting. Extensive evaluations across six distinct BCI tasks demonstrate that EvoBrain consistently surpasses state-of-the-art methods across diverse foundation backbones, optimally balancing plasticity and stability. To our knowledge, this work pioneers cross-task continual learning in the EEG domain, advancing the realization of a unified, one-for-all brain decoding system.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫EvoBrain的持续学习框架，让同一个EEG基础模型能顺序学多个不同脑机接口任务而不遗忘，用任务归一化和响应蒸馏解决神经信号分布漂移和灾难性遗忘问题
analysis.claim: 跨异构BCI任务的持续学习是实现统一EEG基础模型的关键路径，而EvoBrain通过NSN和RAD双机制首次在EEG领域实现了有效的跨任务持续解码
analysis.input: 原始或预处理的EEG时序信号（含多通道）
analysis.output: 任务特定的解码结果（如运动想象类别、SSVEP频率、P300目标等）
analysis.robot_dependency: none
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开/私有EEG数据集，无真实在线脑机闭环实验，未使用任何实时神经反馈硬件系统
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在离线静态数据集上验证6个分类型BCI任务的顺序学习效果，无在线适应、无真实用户闭环、无跨被试泛化验证；相比标尺中所有90+分工作（均含真实神经闭环、临床级功能输出、长期植入/穿戴验证），本文纯属算法层面的范式迁移尝试，贡献限于EEG小圈子内的方法整合，未触及BCI核心瓶颈（信噪比低、个体差异大、非平稳性、延迟敏感、闭环稳定性）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将CV/NLP领域的持续学习思路迁移到EEG分类任务，但未解决BCI本质挑战，也未验证真实交互有效性

papers.title: GN0: Toward a Unified Paradigm for Generation, Evaluation, and Policy Learning in Visual-Language Navigation
papers.abstract: Embodied navigation connects intelligent agents with the physical world and is fundamental for general robotic intelligence. Limited availability and quality of navigation data have constrained Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) systems' generalization and long-horizon capabilities. To address this, we curate diverse 3D scenes and develop an automated pipeline for large-scale navigation data, resulting in the GN-Matrix dataset. Building on a 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) engine, we introduce a high-fidelity simulation platform supporting interactive roaming and collision-aware navigation. We further propose GN-Bench, the first BEV-based benchmark incorporating dynamic 3DGS avatars for human-robot interaction evaluation. To leverage the simulator, we develop an RL-driven navigation foundation model, Break and Establish (BAE). After supervised learning, DAgger exposes the model to rollout-induced states, breaking narrow expert-centric distributions and enabling downstream RL exploration. This unified VLN paradigm integrates map-based and map-free tasks, including instruction following, human following, and goal navigation. GN-BAE formalizes high-fidelity 3DGS-rendered Bird's Eye View representations as compact memory, unlocking latent spatial reasoning in VLMs. Extensive evaluations on GN-Bench and VLN-CE show that GN0 outperforms state-of-the-art VLN methods. Overall, GN-Matrix offers a unified framework spanning data, simulation, and learning, advancing embodied navigation in research and industrial applications.

analysis.tldr: 用3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）构建高保真仿真环境，自动生成大规模导航数据集GN-Matrix，提出BEV+3DGS动态人形交互评测基准GN-Bench，并基于此训练一个支持多任务（指令跟随/人类跟随/目标导航）的RL驱动导航基础模型GN-BAE，但所有实验均在仿真中完成，无真实机器人验证。
analysis.claim: 通过3DGS驱动的高保真仿真、自动化数据生成与BEV+动态avatar评测，实现生成、评估与策略学习三者统一的VLN新范式。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令+RGB-D观测（隐含于3DGS渲染输入）
analysis.output: 动作序列（离散/连续控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研3DGS仿真器（无对应真实机器人平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部为合成数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽整合3DGS、BEV、动态avatar等新元素并提出统一范式，但未突破VLN长期瓶颈（如长程泛化、真实世界鲁棒性），所有结果限于单仿真器内、无真实硬件验证、无跨机体/跨场景泛化证据，benchmark仅新增动态交互维度但未被社区复现或采纳，属扎实但窄域的仿真增量工作，远未达RT-2/π0/OpenVLA等基石级分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将3DGS、BEV和DAgger式RL训练做了系统性串联，但仍是仿真闭环内的方法堆叠，缺乏真实世界锚点和范式颠覆性。

papers.title: Robust Frequency-Calibrated Virtual EEG Channel Generation from Four Frontal Electrodes for Wearable EEG Augmentation
papers.abstract: Low-channel wearable electroencephalography (EEG) is attractive for long-term monitoring, but four frontal electrodes provide only a sparse and spatially biased view of distributed scalp activity. We present FAVC-Net, a compact frequency-calibrated virtual-channel network that generates 13 unmeasured EEG channels from Fp1, Fp2, F7, and F8. The model combines shared multi-scale source encoding, source-state embeddings, target-conditioned signed source-block mixing, GATv2-based attention refinement, attention-consistent skip fusion, and weak Welch power spectral density calibration. Rather than treating sparse-to-dense EEG generation as a purely waveform-matching task, the framework jointly emphasizes amplitude fidelity, spectral allocation, channel-frequency texture, and robustness to corrupted wearable inputs. On the PRED+CT dataset, FAVC-Net achieved the best joint waveform-spectral operating point among neural and interpolation baselines. Its time-domain gains were modest, whereas log-spectral distance and PSD KL divergence were reduced by 30.09% and 37.98% relative to the strongest non-FAVC comparator. Under wearable-like source perturbations, the model preserved spectral fidelity and resisted spectral collapse. These results support virtual EEG channel generation as a dual-domain augmentation problem, while emphasizing that generated posterior and parietal channels should be interpreted as frequency-calibrated representations derived from sparse frontal measurements rather than as independent physical recordings.

analysis.tldr: 用4个前额电极的原始EEG信号，通过一个轻量神经网络FAVC-Net生成13个虚拟后部/顶部电极信号，重点不是拟合波形，而是校准频谱特性（如功率谱密度），让生成通道在频域上可靠可用。
analysis.claim: 稀疏前额EEG通道的虚拟扩展应被建模为双域（时域+频域）校准问题，而非单纯波形插值；频谱保真度比波形相似性更能决定生成通道在下游脑机接口任务中的实用性。
analysis.input: 4通道原始EEG时序信号（Fp1, Fp2, F7, F8）
analysis.output: 13个虚拟电极的EEG时序信号及其对应频谱表示（Welch PSD）
analysis.robot_dependency: none
analysis.data_dependency: 仅依赖公开PRED+CT数据集（含同步高密度EEG记录），未使用任何真实机器人或闭环控制实验数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属EEG信号处理中的稳健插值改进，聚焦频谱校准这一合理但窄切口；无真实BCI闭环验证、无跨被试泛化、无下游任务（如解码/控制）增益证明，仅报告PSD指标提升；与所列基石工作（全为真实神经接口闭环控制、高临床价值、多被试长期部署）相比，属于纯离线信号增强的扎实但低层级技术改进，未触及脑机接口核心瓶颈。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——是EEG预处理环节的稳健性改良，未进入BCI闭环控制或神经解码主干链路，对领域真实进展影响微弱。

papers.title: Intercepting the Future: Latent-Space Predictive World Model for Dynamic VLA Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models generalize across static manipulation but fail when objects move during task execution. They map the current observation to an action and assume the scene is stationary between observation and execution, so at any non-trivial object speed the resulting latency exceeds the time available to grasp. We close this gap with AHEAD (Anticipatory Horizon Extrapolation with Adaptive Dynamics), a predict-then-act wrapper that augments a frozen VLA with a motion-aware latent world model. A small world model trained on manipulation video forecasts future patch tokens in the VLA's feature space, conditioned on per-token velocity and acceleration from optical flow. A language-and-motion saliency mask concentrates prediction on task-relevant patches, and the model rolls forward for an adaptive horizon, halting when prediction uncertainty crosses a threshold. The frozen action decoder then receives the predicted future tokens in place of the current ones. AHEAD adds 4.9M parameters to a frozen 7B OpenVLA and reaches 79 to 97% success across 20 dynamic simulation scenarios where the strongest baseline reaches 31 to 58%. On a physical UFactory xArm 7, AHEAD succeeds on 29/30 to 30/30 on three conveyor and rolling-ball tasks, 23/30 on paddle interception, and 19/30 on projectile catching where every baseline scores 0/30.

analysis.tldr: 给静态VLA模型加了一个轻量级的未来状态预测模块，让它能预判移动物体的位置，从而在真实动态场景中（如接球、拦截滚动小球）成功执行操作，而原有VLA模型在这些任务上完全失败。
analysis.claim: 通过在冻结VLA模型前插入一个运动感知的潜空间世界模型，可显著提升其在动态视觉-语言-动作任务中的实时操作成功率，且无需微调原始VLA。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧+语言指令+光学流估计的每token速度与加速度
analysis.output: 未来时刻的潜空间patch token（供冻结VLA解码器使用）
analysis.robot_dependency: UFactory xArm 7 + PyBullet/Gazebo仿真器（摘要未明说但'20 dynamic simulation scenarios'和xArm实机对应典型仿真+真机验证链）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真生成的带运动标注的视频数据训练世界模型；未使用真实机器人交互数据（仅用仿真视频预训练，实机零微调）
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了VLA向动态环境落地的关键瓶颈（动作延迟与场景变化不匹配），在多任务真机上取得压倒性优势（尤其0→19/30的projectile catching），但世界模型本身是轻量级token-level预测而非端到端动力学建模，未达DreamerV3等基石级通用世界模型的抽象深度与泛化广度。

papers.title: FreeForm: Reduced-Order Deformable Simulation from Particle-Based Skinning Eigenmodes
papers.abstract: We present a novel formulation for mesh-free, reduced-order simulation of deformable hyperelastic objects. Existing work in reduced-order elastodynamic simulation represents the input geometry by either meshes, which can be difficult to obtain due to challenges in scanning and triangulating complex shapes, or by neural fields that require per-shape optimization. We propose to adopt a Reproducing Kernel Particle Method (RKPM) representation, which enables the construction of reduced-order skinning weights by solving a generalized eigensystem on the Hessian matrix of the elastic energy. We demonstrate that this formulation not only leads to a 40x training speedup compared with the per-shape optimization of neural fields, but also achieves lower simulation error when evaluated against the converged results of finite element method. We show our simulation results on a wide variety of objects in different representations including meshes and Gaussian splats, as well as the application of our method in the downstream task of robot simulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫FreeForm的新方法，用无网格的粒子法（RKPM）加弹性能量Hessian矩阵的特征模态来建模软体物体形变，不用依赖三角网格或逐物体训练的神经场，更快更准地做降阶仿真，并用在机器人仿真下游任务中。
analysis.claim: 基于RKPM粒子表示和弹性能量Hessian特征模态的皮肤权重构造，可实现免网格、免逐形优化、高精度、高速度的降阶软体仿真。
analysis.input: 粒子分布（RKPM表示）+弹性材料参数+外力
analysis.output: 形变轨迹（节点/粒子位移序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: none
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需材料参数与几何表示（如点云、高斯溅射、网格）
analysis.significance_reason: 属计算力学/仿真底层方法改进，对具身智能中软体交互有潜在价值，但未在真实机器人上验证、未接入感知-决策闭环、未展示跨物体泛化能力，也未与主流机器人仿真框架（如Isaac Gym、Mujoco、SAPIEN）深度集成；相比RT-2等里程碑工作，它解决的是子模块精度与效率问题，而非具身智能核心挑战（如语言驱动动作生成、跨任务策略泛化、真实世界部署），属于扎实的仿真技术增量，但离‘具身智能领域显著推进’尚远。

papers.title: Dynamic Resilient Spatio-Semantic Memory with Hybrid Localization for Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract: Reliable mobile manipulation in dynamic indoor environments requires a scene representation that remains geometrically consistent, semantically queryable, and computationally bounded as the environment changes. Existing systems often rely on pre-built maps, static-scene assumptions, or highly accurate camera poses, which can lead to stale or misaligned scene information when target objects are relocated or pose estimates are corrected. This paper presents DREAM, a real-robot mobile manipulation framework that integrates perception, memory, localization, navigation, and manipulation in previously unseen indoor environments without a pre-built map. DREAM constructs an online spatio-semantic voxel memory from RGB-D observations registered by a LiDAR-inertial-visual SLAM backend. It further introduces pose-graph-aware Redundancy-Aware Memory Pruning (RMP) to update historical observations after pose corrections while keeping long-horizon observation history bounded. For target localization and reacquisition, DREAM combines language-conditioned 3D retrieval, open-vocabulary image detection, and multimodal large language model based semantic verification. Real-robot experiments in four dynamic indoor laboratory scenes show that DREAM improves long-horizon task success rates from 40%-60% with DynaMem to 55%-70%, while maintaining a memory footprint of 0.37-0.63 GB and an online memory-update time of 0.43-0.53 s across scenes.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文做了一个叫DREAM的真机移动操作框架，能在没预先建图的动态室内环境中边走边建带语义的3D体素记忆，用激光-惯性-视觉SLAM对齐观测，并设计了一种能随位姿修正自动修剪旧记忆的机制，最后靠语言+图像+多模态大模型联合定位目标物体。
analysis.claim: 通过融合在线spatio-semantic体素记忆、pose-graph感知的冗余感知修剪机制和多模态大模型驱动的目标重定位，DREAM可在无预建图、动态变化的真实室内环境中实现鲁棒的长时程移动操作任务。

analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（导航+抓取）及目标物体3D空间位置

papers.title: OptiWorld: Optimal Control for Video World Generation under Physical Constraints
papers.abstract: Video generation models are becoming a scalable form of world models, but they mainly generate plausible motion rather than proactively control or optimize the underlying dynamics. As a result, an object in the generated video may follow trajectories that are unsafe, not smooth, inefficient, or physically inconsistent. In this work, we propose \textbf{OptiWorld}, a framework that brings classical optimal control into video generation at inference time. OptiWorld first extracts a compact, task-relevant world state, then plans an optimal trajectory under physical constraints, and finally renders the video conditioned on this trajectory. We formulate planning as a geometric problem on a continuous manifold, which converts 3D geometry and task-dependent physical constraints into a unified planning geometry. By adding this optimal-control layer, OptiWorld generates videos with preferable dynamics, demonstrating strong potential in multiple tasks including goal-conditioned image-to-video generation, video dynamics editing, and counterfactual generation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把经典最优控制（如轨迹优化）插进视频生成模型的推理流程里，先提取简化的世界状态，再在物理约束下规划最优轨迹，最后据此生成视频，目标是让生成的物体运动更安全、平滑、高效、符合物理规律。
analysis.claim: 将最优控制显式嵌入视频生成的推理链中，通过在连续流形上建模物理与任务约束，实现物理一致、可优化的视频世界生成。
analysis.input: 初始图像+语言/几何任务指令（如目标位置、编辑意图）
analysis.output: 物理合理的视频帧序列（含隐式动力学轨迹）

papers.title: WALL-WM: Carving World Action Modeling at the Event Joints
papers.abstract: WALL-WM is a World Action Model that shifts video-action learning from chunk-centric optimization to event-grounded Vision-Language-Action pretraining, using semantically coherent action events as the atomic unit of learning. Existing WAMs commonly initialize from multimodal or video foundation models and then optimize fixed-length action chunks conditioned directly on the current observation and instruction. Although convenient, this chunk-centric formulation creates a fundamental granularity mismatch. Language describes semantic goals and events, vision evolves through continuous scene dynamics, and actions operate at control-level timescales; forcing all three into the same fixed-length prediction window turns VLA training into short-horizon correlation fitting. WALL-WM addresses this mismatch by organizing both supervision and data around semantic events. Specifically, it pairs event-grounded VLA pretraining with a data ecosystem built from event-level captions and cluster-balanced sampling, enabling scalable learning over diverse behaviors, scenes, and task structures. From the same event-pretrained backbone, WALL-WM supports two complementary inference modes. The event mode consumes next-event descriptions and enables variable-length execution chunks, while the unified mode uses a VLM with Staircase Decoding to condition conventional fixed-length chunk inference while preserving a gradient-continuous VLA path. Together with Muon-optimizer-based large-scale pretraining infrastructure, WALL-WM provides a practical scale-up recipe for general-purpose WAMs. Experiments show that WALL-WM generalizes broadly across language, scenes, and tasks, achieving state-of-the-art performance in large-scale real-world generalization evaluation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出WALL-WM，用语义事件（而非固定时长的动作块）作为视频-语言-动作联合建模的基本单元，重构了世界动作模型的预训练范式，试图解决语言目标、视觉动态和控制频率在时间粒度上的根本错配问题。
analysis.claim: 语义事件是视频-语言-动作联合建模更自然、更可扩展的原子单位，能从根本上缓解语言目标、视觉演化与动作控制之间的时间粒度错配。

analysis.output: 动作块/轨迹（支持两种模式：事件驱动的变长执行块，或固定长度但梯度连续的统一解码块）
